Does he have to actually pull the trigger?Peter,
In our recent debate, I pressed Abigail Spanberger to take a clear stand on Jay Jones, and I refused to back down. I asked her point-blank why she wouldn't say that Jones' remarks were not okay and that he must leave the race.
And you know what? She still had nothing to say.
That's not leadership. That's cowardice. And it's a clear sign that Abigail Spanberger has no business being elected Governor.
But I am. I'm a leader who will always stand up for what's right, even when it's hard. I'm a leader who will always fight for our values and our way of life. And I'm a leader who needs your support to win this election.

Right now, EMILYs List women are prepping for Election Day. They’re charging phones and tablets. They're packing water bottles and snacks for canvas kickoffs. They're making sure we have legal hotlines staffed and ready to go if anyone faces problems casting their ballot.

I've been doing this work for years, and Election Day eve always feels the same — like we're right on the edge of something huge, and every single detail matters. Did we reach enough voters? Do we have enough volunteers at each location? Are we ready for whatever tomorrow throws at us?

The truth is, we won't know the results until tomorrow night. Or maybe even in the days and weeks that follow for some races. But what I do know is this: We've built something incredible. We've recruited amazing candidates and supported campaigns that actually reflect our values. And the wins we have this year will be the model for how we win and secure

And tonight, in these last few hours, we can make sure we're as ready as possible for tomorrow.

clean_body: I'm writing from the road — in a few hours, voters will decide what happens next. | = Peter, I'm writing to you from the road — I've been traveling nonstop these last few weeks, and I've been thinking a lot about what happens next. In just a few hours, these elections will determine where our country goes from here. Will we elect Republicans who blindly follow Trump's lead? Or will we elect Democratic pro-choice women who will fight against his dangerous and chaotic agenda? = | = Right now, EMILYs List women are prepping for Election Day. They’re charging phones and tablets. They're packing water bottles and snacks for canvas kickoffs. They're making sure we have legal hotlines staffed and ready to go if anyone faces problems casting their ballot. I've been doing this work for years, and Election Day eve always feels the same — like we're right on the edge of something huge, and every single detail matters. Did we reach enough voters? Do we have enough volunteers at each location? Are we ready for whatever tomorrow throws at us? The truth is, we won't know the results until tomorrow night. Or maybe even in the days and weeks that follow for some races. But what I do know is this: We've built something incredible. We've recruited amazing candidates and supported campaigns that actually reflect our values. And the wins we have this year will be the model for how we win and secure And tonight, in these last few hours, we can make sure we're as ready as possible for tomorrow. **=** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for standing with EMILYs List, Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers) President, EMILYs List = = | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Peter,
I just got back from Queens, New York, where I stood shoulder to shoulder with Zohran Mamdani. Zohran is unafraid to take on entrenched power, to fight for working families, and to imagine a city where public transit, childcare, and housing are affordable for all.
If you had told me when I was growing up in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, that there would be an Indian-American of Hindu faith representing Silicon Valley, introducing an African-born Indian of Muslim faith, who would be the next mayor of New York, I would have told you only in a Mira Nair film, but it's happening.
https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1985380548508783085 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1985380548508783085]
We both believe that the wealthiest country in the world should work for the many, not the few.
Right now, people can’t afford rent or childcare. Healthcare and SNAP benefits are being cut. Taxing billionaires so that people can have access to healthcare and education isn’t radical; it’s common sense.
New York has a chance to send a powerful message to the nation: that moral clarity and economic justice can still win – not just in Queens, but in rural communities and factory towns across America.
Please watch and share my speech from his rally and join me in supporting Zohran Mamdani’s campaign for Mayor of New York City. [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1985380548508783085]
Thank you for your activism and all that you do.
In solidarity,
Ro
Wait! One more thing–
Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. # Mansharamani Musings

| | October was a hectic month. I spent time meeting and speaking with business executives, government leaders, academics and journalists around the country (and the Western Hemisphere). See below for links to my recent reflections on global developments...
Happy November!
[_B_](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=b13589cff0&e=93b2c2b824) _est,**

| | OCTOBER 5, 2025

Rising tensions in the Caribbean Sea and with Venezuela have led pundits and policymakers alike to ask questions about the coherence of the Trump Administration’s foreign policy. Many are confused, noting the seeming inconsistency of an America First rhetoric and the use of military force against an adversary. The [declaration](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=45ae340ee2&e=93b2c2b824) of war on drug cartels, [designation](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=7139002804&e=93b2c2b824) of these groups as terrorist organizations, and [military strikes](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=b52159cd10&e=93b2c2b824) against them is the precise type of foreign policy that agitates Trump’s base of supporters. There has even been talk of [regime change](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=44ac9b84a5&e=93b2c2b824), the _bete noire_ of the populist right.
Trump’s posture towards Venezuela has always...

| | OCTOBER 12, 2025

Long-time readers know that I have long championed a generalist rather than specialist approach to navigating uncertainty. It is my belief that experts by their very nature live in silos and tend to view most developments through the narrow lens of their specific microscope. This leads to depth of expertise, but the flip side of that dynamic is that specialists tend to lack breadth of perspective. They tend to overlook the proverbial “big picture.”
The most effective approach to navigating uncertainty, I contend, is to look across silos and connect dots rather than focus on generating dots. My second book, [Think for Yourself: Restoring Common Sense in an Age of Experts and Artificial Intelligence](https://mansharamani.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=caf139d4582deef486da11685&id=bbcae63b00&e=93b2c2b824), is about how experts should be consulted but not empowered (“Keep Experts on Tap, Not on Top” is the title of one of the chapters). For far too long, the all-Republican Public Service Commission has approved one utility rate hike after another.
Georgians' power bills keep climbing, but Tim and Fitz didn’t seem to mind — **they’ve taken hundreds of thousands** from donors tied to the same utility companies making billions off us.

We can’t risk losing California’s leadership when the country needs us the most.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40358%2E3422442%2EU6SMDJ)
Peter,
Tomorrow, California has the chance to take a real stand for our democracy by voting **YES on Proposition 50.**
Prop 50 would let California voters redraw our congressional maps after Texas Republicans, at Donald Trump’s order, gerrymandered five seats away from Democrats. If we pass it, we can cancel out their power grab and make sure voters, not politicians, decide elections. Watch me explain what’s at stake:
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20251103_1_ak.WwxsD7&refcode=em20251103-40358&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40358%2E3422442%2EU6SMDJ)

Governor Newsom is term-limited, and there is no guarantee our next governor would stand up to Trump with a measure like Prop 50. Remember, _a new poll shows a Republican leading this race_. We can’t risk losing California’s leadership when the country needs us the most.
I’m running to make sure we look after working Californians and do everything we possibly can to protect our democracy. But consolidating support in this race will take a whole lot of grit. I’ve counted on Porter Supporters like you before, and now I have another important ask.

Tomorrow is the beginning of the end of the political potency of dumpy, silicon-based life form TACO Trump.
The 37% approval man has Marjorie Taylor Greene barking at him, keeps burying the Epstein files--dude must've never seen Pet Sematary--and has elegant splotches of purple on his stub-hands that really ties the orange face-paint together nicely.
But his problem, and the good news for all of us who haven't really taken to fascism or Trump-fellatio, is a new crop of charismatic, tech-savvy Democrats are--finally!--emerging. Ones that don't poll what toilet paper to use, endure a panic attack every chance they get to message and actually know how to use "the Tik Tok."
The truism is true, the medium is the message, and those who know how to use it are the messengers we need.
Subscribe if you're ready for a new era!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.156oFJgfFUd3U1zaKg45wCrOvQZeAeV4Yig5lNQmmxc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=177916170)
Trump is authentic. Sure, in the same way any semi-sentient, serial-lying, mega-splash of pig vomit assaulting your senses would be. But his shoot-from-his-likely-broken-hip style has made him seem real, in an age of reality tv and real war-zone footage arriving via cell phone in seconds from across the world.
Democratic leaders in DC...are anything but authentic. They're still so impotent in challenging Trump, possess so little clue about inspiring the base (a round of subsidies and tax credits on the House!) and [can't seem to remind big donors that income inequality at our current level](https://substack.com/redirect/6a8f204b-f165-4c7f-83e4-b7000c3345c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) usually ends with public guillotines.
For other examples, just translate that into Russian. Or German. Or Confederate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a8f204b-f165-4c7f-83e4-b7000c3345c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc329c60-b590-45a7-85c5-62f93a964925?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Thankfully, many Democrats across the country, are no longer listening to the "we can return to pre-Trump times, but a little better" crowd of Democrats, who have no understanding of the moment, and how it will shape the next century.
We're seeing more of our candidates talk like they're hanging out on a livestream rather than reading off a prompter. They crash into cameras, riff live on social platforms, and let their personalities bleed through the script.
State Assemblyman Zohran Mamdani has utilized this strategy all the way to a likely blowout victory tomorrow, when he will become New York City's next Mayor. The video at the top of this post gives you an idea how he's done it.
Mamdani's mix of subway-riding authenticity, marathon tees reading "Eric Adams Raised My Rent!" and unapologetic calls for city-run grocery stores and fare-free buses are the combo of personality, policy and be-your-own-press needed in this age.
_**[Ed Note: I 'm only discussing Dem strategy, charisma & digital media. I strongly believe at some point Mamdani must address his "both sides" take on Oct 7. But that's for another day].**_
In Virginia, Abigail Spanberger--former CIA officer and three-term Congresswoman brings that same off-script feel. She talks in plain language to audiences beyond the beltway and deploys digital tools with a genuine voice, not a stiff campaign-video face.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a8f204b-f165-4c7f-83e4-b7000c3345c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Subscribe for more Cliff in your inbox!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.156oFJgfFUd3U1zaKg45wCrOvQZeAeV4Yig5lNQmmxc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=177916170)
I spoke to ad maker Will Robinson, who's screamed from the rooftops about Democrats' trailing Republicans in connecting with communities they wish to reach, embracing local influencers and being genuine in communications efforts.
Will pointed out Spanberger, in her Virginia Governor race, "shook up her campaign budget" to do fewer tv ads and "put significantly more into digital and streaming." In fact, she ran a $1 million ad campaign specifically for digital and streaming platforms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8bbb746d-b413-409a-9976-4d91eb458fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Spanberger also targeted key groups, hammering how she'd crush Trumpflation--"The Affordable Virginia Plan--**and** using social media to respond to the usual late-great-Hannibal-Lecter lies GOPers tell about Democrats on crime.
This has been crucial, as many of these kinds of lies were not answered in 2024. And seemingly it's all working, as _Spanberger is up by double digits in polls, on her way to a rout._
Meanwhile, in New Jersey, former Navy officer and federal prosecutor Mikie Sherrill speaks as though she's seen the world, been in the trenches, and calls 'em like she sees 'em. Her authenticity is not borne of flashy stunts.
But the conviction that _her story_ matters, and how she tells it in real-time, including social-media moments, underscore who she really is, what values drive her.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8bbb746d-b413-409a-9976-4d91eb458fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Per Robinson, she did an "excellent job integrating her campaign with local influencers (always more trusted messengers), including teachers, labor and environmental groups." Will noted this was crucial, as "New Jersey is a news dessert."
She also used digital ads to tie her despicable opponent to the even more despicable Trump, and defend herself from flying Republican monkeys smearing her military record. Luckily for Sherrill, they often give up because of all the bone spurs.
In any case, Sherrill is also up, and set to win by a solid margin. Or, what you'd call a clean-MAGA-ass kicking when looking at all three headline races. When Democrats win them all tomorrow night, it'll be on the 5th time that's happened in U.S. history.
And some who are already running for big races next year are seeing what is working and running with it, also preparing to skewer some GOP derriere.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc329c60-b590-45a7-85c5-62f93a964925?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In Texas, (U.S. Sen candidate) James Talarico's viral takes on faith and policy show he's comfortable mixing sincerity with social-media savvy. On No Kings Day, Michigan (U.S. Sen candidate) Mallory McMorrow did impromptu chats with protesters, quizzing, laughing with them and having the time of her life.
Voters are tired of candidates who sound like talking mannequins. We will win next year. Big. [But do we want big, or FDR big?](https://substack.com/redirect/8bbb746d-b413-409a-9976-4d91eb458fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Because only the latter can provide the reforms and new institutions that ensure the safety of our republic. And it's all sitting right there for the taking, if we're willing to be bold.
In this environment, authenticity is a strategic virtue. The cultural script has changed: Gen Y, Gen Z, even older voters, aren't buying the "I-love-this-country" mask anymore--they want the voice that acknowledges "you've been screwed by the system," "I'll fight for you," and "I'll tell you the truth, even when it hurts."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b23a29e8-f325-41d7-88d2-e45a223e22e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In fact, we recently talked to three we we strongly support on _Amped Up_. All with incredible personal stories informing their values--fighting for us through real change to our democracy and economy, and by battling Trump and his billionaires.
[Fred Wellman is running for Congress in a swing seat](https://substack.com/redirect/342c667b-a3e2-49a0-89a5-8ce5606ba9ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Missouri. [Greg Landsman is running for reelection to Congress in Ohio](https://substack.com/redirect/ddb062f4-f081-41aa-8e4d-a9d3c2328e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and they just made his seat harder to win with a cheap last-minute gerrymander. And [Lt. Governor Garlin Gilchrest is running for Governor of Michigan](https://substack.com/redirect/a89193b0-b731-4bc1-a5f1-2c6075107cab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). All three are what we've been talking about here!
Stay in the loop. Subscribe for free!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.156oFJgfFUd3U1zaKg45wCrOvQZeAeV4Yig5lNQmmxc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=177916170)
Folks, Democrats are undergoing a reboot, with new stars less about "we promise everything" and more "[here's who I am, here's how I got here, and here's what I'll fight for.](https://substack.com/redirect/8bbb746d-b413-409a-9976-4d91eb458fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" They lean into their backstories--housing counselor, Navy prosecutor, educator-legislator--and mix policy with personal narrative via social channels.
If the old political adage was "message discipline," the new one is "message authenticity." They show it in how they talk, how they post, and how they show up.
Tomorrow and next year they'll show it in how they kick MAGA a** and take our country back.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc329c60-b590-45a7-85c5-62f93a964925?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

clean_body: Watch now (1 min) | From New York to Virginia, candidates like Zohran Mamdani and Abigail Spanberger are proving that speaking human--and digital--wins elections. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? | | From New York to Virginia, candidates like Zohran Mamdani and Abigail Spanberger are proving that speaking human--and digital--wins elections. | | and | Nov 4 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Tomorrow is the beginning of the end of the political potency of dumpy, silicon-based life form TACO Trump. The 37% approval man has Marjorie Taylor Greene barking at him, keeps burying the Epstein files--dude must've never seen Pet Sematary--and has elegant splotches of purple on his stub-hands that really ties the orange face-paint together nicely. But his problem, and the good news for all of us who haven't really taken to fascism or Trump-fellatio, is a new crop of charismatic, tech-savvy Democrats are--finally!--emerging. Ones that don't poll what toilet paper to use, endure a panic attack every chance they get to message and actually know how to use "the Tik Tok." The truism is true, the medium is the message, and those who know how to use it are the messengers we need. Subscribe if you're ready for a new era! Trump is authentic. Sure, in the same way any semi-sentient, serial-lying, mega-splash of pig vomit assaulting your senses would be. But his shoot-from-his-likely-broken-hip style has made him seem real, in an age of reality tv and real war-zone footage arriving via cell phone in seconds from across the world. Democratic leaders in DC...are anything but authentic. They're still so impotent in challenging Trump, possess so little clue about inspiring the base (a round of subsidies and tax credits on the House!) and usually ends with public guillotines. For other examples, just translate that into Russian. Or German. Or Confederate. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Thankfully, many Democrats across the country, are no longer listening to the "we can return to pre-Trump times, but a little better" crowd of Democrats, who have no understanding of the moment, and how it will shape the next century. We're seeing more of our candidates talk like they're hanging out on a livestream rather than reading off a prompter. They crash into cameras, riff live on social platforms, and let their personalities bleed through the script. State Assemblyman Zohran Mamdani has utilized this strategy all the way to a likely blowout victory tomorrow, when he will become New York City's next Mayor. The video at the top of this post gives you an idea how he's done it. Mamdani's mix of subway-riding authenticity, marathon tees reading "Eric Adams Raised My Rent!" and unapologetic calls for city-run grocery stores and fare-free buses are the combo of personality, policy and be-your-own-press needed in this age. [Ed Note: I 'm only discussing Dem strategy, charisma & digital media. I strongly believe at some point Mamdani must address his "both sides" take on Oct 7. But that's for another day]. In Virginia, Abigail Spanberger--former CIA officer and three-term Congresswoman brings that same off-script feel. She talks in plain language to audiences beyond the beltway and deploys digital tools with a genuine voice, not a stiff campaign-video face. | | ---|---|--- Subscribe for more Cliff in your inbox! I spoke to ad maker Will Robinson, who's screamed from the rooftops about Democrats' trailing Republicans in connecting with communities they wish to reach, embracing local influencers and being genuine in communications efforts. Will pointed out Spanberger, in her Virginia Governor race, "shook up her campaign budget" to do fewer tv ads and "put significantly more into digital and streaming." In fact, she ran a $1 million ad campaign specifically for digital and streaming platforms. | | ---|---|--- Spanberger also targeted key groups, hammering how she'd crush Trumpflation--"The Affordable Virginia Plan--and using social media to respond to the usual late-great-Hannibal-Lecter lies GOPers tell about Democrats on crime. This has been crucial, as many of these kinds of lies were not answered in 2024. And seemingly it's all working, as Spanberger is up by double digits in polls, on her way to a rout. Meanwhile, in New Jersey, former Navy officer and federal prosecutor Mikie Sherrill speaks as though she's seen the world, been in the trenches, and calls 'em like she sees 'em. Her authenticity is not borne of flashy stunts. But the conviction that her story matters, and how she tells it in real-time, including social-media moments, underscore who she really is, what values drive her. | | ---|---|--- Per Robinson, she did an "excellent job integrating her campaign with local influencers (always more trusted messengers), including teachers, labor and environmental groups." Will noted this was crucial, as "New Jersey is a news dessert." She also used digital ads to tie her despicable opponent to the even more despicable Trump, and defend herself from flying Republican monkeys smearing her military record. Luckily for Sherrill, they often give up because of all the bone spurs. In any case, Sherrill is also up, and set to win by a solid margin. Or, what you'd call a clean-MAGA-ass kicking when looking at all three headline races. When Democrats win them all tomorrow night, it'll be on the 5th time that's happened in U.S. history. And some who are already running for big races next year are seeing what is working and running with it, also preparing to skewer some GOP derriere. | | ---|---|--- In Texas, (U.S. Sen candidate) James Talarico's viral takes on faith and policy show he's comfortable mixing sincerity with social-media savvy. On No Kings Day, Michigan (U.S. Sen candidate) Mallory McMorrow did impromptu chats with protesters, quizzing, laughing with them and having the time of her life. Voters are tired of candidates who sound like talking mannequins. We will win next year. Big. Because only the latter can provide the reforms and new institutions that ensure the safety of our republic. And it's all sitting right there for the taking, if we're willing to be bold. In this environment, authenticity is a strategic virtue. The cultural script has changed: Gen Y, Gen Z, even older voters, aren't buying the "I-love-this-country" mask anymore--they want the voice that acknowledges "you've been screwed by the system," "I'll fight for you," and "I'll tell you the truth, even when it hurts." | | ---|---|--- In fact, we recently talked to three we we strongly support on Amped Up. All with incredible personal stories informing their values--fighting for us through real change to our democracy and economy, and by battling Trump and his billionaires. in Missouri. they just made his seat harder to win with a cheap last-minute gerrymander. And . All three are what we've been talking about here! Stay in the loop. Subscribe for free! Folks, Democrats are undergoing a reboot, with new stars less about "we promise everything" and more "" They lean into their backstories--housing counselor, Navy prosecutor, educator-legislator--and mix policy with personal narrative via social channels. If the old political adage was "message discipline," the new one is "message authenticity." They show it in how they talk, how they post, and how they show up. Peter, **Tomorrow is Election Day in states across the country.** The will of the people is what makes a democracy a democracy—and the right to vote is the most fundamental American value we have. It’ s critical that We the People participate and make our voices heard, now more than ever. **Is there an election near you tomorrow?** Visit [vote.org](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.HKq80qftWJFuUvNf2U4sGQ9fhz0uQi590eZcZVi-TwBKSI9f18QQcMQDWm_J1IdfY_aLNRxZmjCuJs07LTHM2XDFLhATCM5Oeeu2p83Kq-LhU3zt7Gvstw1bm9Ac0OFLilrLA1wnxUKpMXzFf-Q32GmYVN3PxQTQbC4eUa1JZHFwAM-R05m4h6sxiTtc4tYIu1IYksVziSQfwPu0HuRDMqyCoYoVAyATCfynK-y8IWs/4lb/nxXDAtAuQmiVN7SAFZuLRQ/h0/h001.NLMjGAuIzPlmXHmJUprrfU0qAAItUIq-HfKuTAwb94s) to find out, and then check your registration and find your polling place. And there are even more local elections that are so crucial to our democracy. **We don’t have a democracy without the vote of the people. If you have the opportunity to cast a ballot tomorrow, please do everything you can to make your voice heard!** [**Visit vote.org to see if there’s an election in your area. Visit to find out, and then check your registration and find your polling place. 7 million people attended last month’s No Kings rallies, making it the largest single-day demonstration in American history. The elections tomorrow give us an opportunity to stand up and be heard at the ballot box, not just in the streets. New York City will elect a new mayor. Trump has long lied about mail-in voting. He's claimed mail-in voting contributed to his 2020 election loss, though no widespread fraud has been found. In fact, the one case of mail-in ballot fraud in Pennsylvania after the 2020 election was a man who was prosecuted for returning his dead mother's ballot for Trump .
We all know just how safe and secure mail-in voting is. It's use dates back to the Civil War. The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.
Being blunt: There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access. There is no good-faith reason to end the use of mail-in voting, or do the other things in this forthcoming executive order or his previous one attacking vote-by-mail. **Akbar’s campaign has already knocked his entire universe of doors — _twice._ And they aren’t stopping until polls close.** Akbar knows that showing up and meeting voters where they are is what will get him across the finish line.
He’s even been taking two interpreters with him when he travels around his incredibly diverse district, talking with local leaders and business owners, because he knows how important it is that every member of his community has their voices heard. Many of whom are just shocked he even talked with them in the first place.
From those conversations, he’s built a platform to expand Medicaid, protect SNAP, improve public schools, and address the everyday challenges people face here.
Akbar’s also tackling the kinds of issues most politicians overlook. For example, one of Akbar’s friends had their HOA confiscate their grill, then fined them $650 but still refused to return the grill. Because of that, Akbar is pushing to limit predatory HOA fines so people aren’t punished for simply enjoying their homes. **That’s what happens when leaders are actually a part of their community and fight for it.**
And there’s one more thing that really stands out in Akbar’s race: The incumbent in this seat, Rep. Shelly Hutchinson, decided not to run again and endorsed 21-year-old Akbar.
It’s rare to see a longtime community leader choosing to uplift the next generation, not push us aside or tell us to wait our turn. That’s the type of intergenerational coalition building Democrats desperately need right now.

# [Our Precious Democracy](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2025%2F11%2F03%2Four-precious-democracy-2%2F%3Fjetpack_skip_subscription_popup&sr=0&signature=c6d03595a97866bc7f40e1e6c3f972b7&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| By **Elizabeth Farnham** on November 3, 2025
---
Because we believe “All...are created EQUAL,” we hold dear our Representative Democracy.
For 250 years, veterans, union members, and civil rights marchers have improved upon our self-governance with their sacrifices to extend to more Americans the right to vote and personal freedoms. When our elected leaders take their oaths to the U.S. Constitution seriously and do the necessary work of representation, regardless of party affiliation, we deliver greatness from our country, and The USA stands as a beacon of Democracy.
As a trusted member of our U.S. Congress, I pledge to:
* Uphold my oath to defend and support the US Constitution.
* Safeguard the rights and power of The American People.
* Legislate in the best interests of Everyday Americans.
* Ensure our national security.
* Maintain solid relationships with our trusted allies.
* Hold accountable those in power who violate our country's laws.
* Pass term limits for justices of the Supreme Court and age limits for US Senators and US Representatives.

To defend and support the U.S. Constitution is to carry out the critical functions of this office. One of the powers of Congress is that of the purse. Congressionally-approved funds use taxpayer dollars to support programs of federal agencies and departments that in turn, support The American People. Yet, in early 2025, the current Trump administration unconstitutionally paused the federal funding of 2600 programs.
After unpausing them, President Trump then allowed his advisor, the wealthiest person on Earth, Elon Musk, to raid several federal agencies. Devoid of appropriate security clearance and, according to the attorneys of federal workers, in violation of laws, union contracts, and civil service agreements, Musk and his illegal Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) helped themselves to classified information as well as the personal information of the American People, then stored it in unsecured files whose whereabouts are unknown. Attempts to subpoena Musk and his associates were thwarted by Republicans in Congress.
Since then, Trump, like a mad king, and his administration have, without consent of Congress; enacted tariffs indiscriminately against several nations, abused the power of the United States military to kill over 60 alleged drug traffickers in the Caribbean sea in violation of US and international laws, abused the power of Immigration Customs Enforcement to detain American citizens without due process, accepted a $400 million jet as a gift from a foreign nation in violation of the Emoluments clause, engaged in speculation and profit through crypto-currency schemes, indicted his political foes on dubious charges, demanded The Department of Justice grant him $230 million dollars in compensation for having been investigated, pardoned January 6th criminals, eroded the trust of our Allies, unjustly fired thousands of federal workers, compromised our national security, threatened to overrun American cities with the National Guards of other states, and torn down the East Wing of The White House.
The Trump administration has violated so many laws, there are currently over 245 legal challenges to it.
Meanwhile, the Republican-controlled Congress does nothing to check Trump's crimes.
PA-13's own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, is a part of that collective silence.
Joyce voted against The Infrastructure Investments and Jobs Act, The Inflation Reduction Act, The American Rescue Plan, and many other important pieces of legislation that are in the interests of Everyday Americans. All of that followed his egregious refusal to certify the valid electoral votes of Pennsylvanians who voted in 2020. This year, Joyce voted twice for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that removes healthcare and food assistance from millions of our neediest Americans, including over 17 thousand constituents in our 13th Congressional District.
The intransigence of elected Republicans, especially those entrenched in power for decades, has now led to a lack of a continuing resolution for our federal budget and a partial shutdown of our federal government.
When Congress ceases to function, the American People have no voice in our own government.
Our U.S. Congress has effectively yielded the power of The People to the executive branch. That's why Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson, handed over his speaker gavel to Trump on July 4th, 2025.
Photo credit: AP News
We cannot risk further erosion of our precious Democracy.
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, for US Representative of Pennsylvania’s 13th District, as I will do everything in my power to protect your right to vote, continue the necessary operation of our government, and be a voice for us because I love my country.

For 250 years, veterans, union members, and civil rights marchers have improved upon our self-governance with their sacrifices to extend to more American... | or | | | or ---|---|--- | By Elizabeth Farnham on November 3, 2025 Because we believe “All...are created EQUAL,” we hold dear our Representative Democracy. For 250 years, veterans, union members, and civil rights marchers have improved upon our self-governance with their sacrifices to extend to more Americans the right to vote and personal freedoms. When our elected leaders take their oaths to the U.S. Constitution seriously and do the necessary work of representation, regardless of party affiliation, we deliver greatness from our country, and The USA stands as a beacon of Democracy. As a trusted member of our U.S. Congress, I pledge to: Uphold my oath to defend and support the US Constitution. Safeguard the rights and power of The American People. Legislate in the best interests of Everyday Americans. Ensure our national security. Maintain solid relationships with our trusted allies. Hold accountable those in power who violate our country's laws. Pass term limits for justices of the Supreme Court and age limits for US Senators and US Representatives. To defend and support the U.S. Constitution is to carry out the critical functions of this office. One of the powers of Congress is that of the purse. Congressionally-approved funds use taxpayer dollars to support programs of federal agencies and departments that in turn, support The American People. Yet, in early 2025, the current Trump administration unconstitutionally paused the federal funding of 2600 programs. After unpausing them, President Trump then allowed his advisor, the wealthiest person on Earth, Elon Musk, to raid several federal agencies. Devoid of appropriate security clearance and, according to the attorneys of federal workers, in violation of laws, union contracts, and civil service agreements, Musk and his illegal Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) helped themselves to classified information as well as the personal information of the American People, then stored it in unsecured files whose whereabouts are unknown. Attempts to subpoena Musk and his associates were thwarted by Republicans in Congress. Since then, Trump, like a mad king, and his administration have, without consent of Congress; enacted tariffs indiscriminately against several nations, abused the power of the United States military to kill over 60 alleged drug traffickers in the Caribbean sea in violation of US and international laws, abused the power of Immigration Customs Enforcement to detain American citizens without due process, accepted a $400 million jet as a gift from a foreign nation in violation of the Emoluments clause, engaged in speculation and profit through crypto-currency schemes, indicted his political foes on dubious charges, demanded The Department of Justice grant him $230 million dollars in compensation for having been investigated, pardoned January 6th criminals, eroded the trust of our Allies, unjustly fired thousands of federal workers, compromised our national security, threatened to overrun American cities with the National Guards of other states, and torn down the East Wing of The White House. The Trump administration has violated so many laws, there are currently over 245 legal challenges to it. Meanwhile, the Republican-controlled Congress does nothing to check Trump's crimes. PA-13's own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, is a part of that collective silence. Joyce voted against The Infrastructure Investments and Jobs Act, The Inflation Reduction Act, The American Rescue Plan, and many other important pieces of legislation that are in the interests of Everyday Americans. All of that followed his egregious refusal to certify the valid electoral votes of Pennsylvanians who voted in 2020. This year, Joyce voted twice for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that removes healthcare and food assistance from millions of our neediest Americans, including over 17 thousand constituents in our 13th Congressional District. The intransigence of elected Republicans, especially those entrenched in power for decades, has now led to a lack of a continuing resolution for our federal budget and a partial shutdown of our federal government. When Congress ceases to function, the American People have no voice in our own government. Our U.S. Congress has effectively yielded the power of The People to the executive branch. That's why Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson, handed over his speaker gavel to Trump on July 4th, 2025. Photo credit: AP News We cannot risk further erosion of our precious Democracy. Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, for US Representative of Pennsylvania’s 13th District, as I will do everything in my power to protect your right to vote, continue the necessary operation of our government, and be a voice for us because I love my country. I served our nation in the US Marine Corps as an electrician & a diesel mechanic. I kept my brothers & sisters on the move and equipped to DEFEND our nation from terrorists & communists. It was during my service that I learned what real leadership and sacrifice are. _**I am forever grateful that I had the privilege to serve and defend our nation, Fellow American.**_

But now, I'm fighting for my friends' and neighbors' freedoms as a civilian. In 2021, I decided to run for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia because I saw that our nation needed a strong Christian, someone who has served this great country, to step up and LEAD!

In 2007, with bipartisan support, George W. Bush signed legislation that created the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Now, Trump is weaponizing the bipartisan program to go after his enemies.
What Trump is doing is against the law — so today, I filed my 46th lawsuit against him. I’ll see the President in court.
Help me keep up the fight against this lawless, power-hungry administration — chip in today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
This loan forgiveness program has helped millions of Americans build careers in public service. It promises that if you serve your community and make loan payments for ten years, your remaining balance will be forgiven. Millions built their lives around that promise — firefighters, 911 dispatchers, nurses, public school teachers, and so many more .
Now, the Trump Administration is pulling the rug from under them. Under this new Department of Education rule, people who work for organizations that are engaged in anything the Trump administration deems to have a “substantial illegal purpose” — legal services to immigrants, DEI initiatives, or civil protest, for example — could be excluded from the program entirely.
Let’s be clear about what’s happening: This is just the latest example of the Trump administration weaponizing the federal government to target those it doesn’t agree with and push its own agenda.
Since January, Trump has used federal power to prosecute people he views as political enemies, to threaten media outlets that criticize him — and even to target critical homeland security and public safety funding for states refusing to cave to his demands.
America’s public servants deserve what they were promised by their government — and the Trump administration deserves to be held accountable to the law. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]

subject: ICYMI: Indiana Is Innovating Education — More Than Any Other State

body:
Under the leadership of Gov. Mike Braun and Secretary of Education Katie Jenner, Indiana is innovating K-12 education from all angles, and the rest of the nation should take note. No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jd/) **IN CASE YOU MISSED IT** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-r/) [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-y/) Discovery Institute
Keri D. Ingraham
October 29th, 2025
[https://www.discovery.org/education/2025/10/29/indiana-is-innovating-education-more-than-any-other-state/](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-j/)On Oct. 17, Indiana submitted a waiver application to the U.S. Department of Education seeking flexibility and a reduction of red tape from Washington. Under the leadership of Gov. Mike Braun and Secretary of Education Katie Jenner, Indiana is innovating K-12 education from all angles, and the rest of the nation should take note.Upon taking office in January, Braun expanded eligibility for the Choice Scholarship Program to all families in the Hoosier State, creating a free market K-12 education landscape. Demand for education options has surged, and providers have responded. In Indiana, private school choices have expanded significantly over the past four years, with enrollment up [22 percent](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-t/).Indiana also offers robust public school choice, including inter-district and intra-district open enrollment, magnet schools, and public charter schools. Indiana has a robust public charter school community that has grown by approximately [40 percent](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-i/) over the last 10 years, resulting in [120 charter schools](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-d/) collectively enrolling upwards of 50,000 students. Furthermore, Indiana could set a national standard for equitable charter school funding, including both facilities and operations.The state is leading the nation in the number of microschools, which are small schools created by individuals referred to as education entrepreneurs or by organizations. While microschools are generally private schools, Indiana also has public microschools. For example, the [Indiana Microschools Collaborative](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-h/) is a public charter network that exists to "create and support innovative, personalized microschools" across the state, each serving 20-75 students. This microschools collaborative was developed by one of Indiana's most innovative public school districts, which is currently part of a small number of schools nationwide that are piloting a competency-based learning model -- an alternative to the traditional credit hour.In this year's legislative session, Indiana removed a major barrier to creating new schools. Braun's May signing of [House Bill 1515](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-k/) ensures that all public, charter, and private schools are permitted in every zoning district -- paving the way for a surge in new microschools and private schools to meet growing demand.The state ranks [third](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-u/) in the nation for "education choice," only trailing Florida and Arizona. Yet beyond school choice, Indiana is forging a new frontier for innovation in education. The school facilities where children are educated and the way kids get to school are experiencing forward-thinking initiatives. For example, [more than fifty](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-p/) Indianapolis public charter and private schools are taking steps to collaborate by sharing transportation and school buildings to expand offerings for students and enhance efficiency, thereby driving down costs.As an advocate for academic accountability, school transparency, and empowering parents to determine the best school for their child, Secretary Jenner believes that "every child has a unique purpose and deserves opportunities to be prepared for future success." Modernizing outdated high school graduation requirements is foundational to preparing students.In December 2024, the Indiana State Board of Education unanimously approved new high school diploma [requirements](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-x/). Arguably, the result is the new gold standard in the country and a model that other states would be wise to adopt and customize accordingly.The base Indiana high school diploma now requires 42 credits, up from the previous minimum of 40 credits. It includes new requirements of one credit in personal finance, computer science, communications, and college and career preparation, as well as two credits in STEM-focused courses.Beyond the base diploma, students can opt to earn readiness seals for Enrollment, Employment, and Enlistment and Service, each offered at the "honors" and "honors plus" levels. Students who graduate with the Enrollment Honors Plus seal are [automatically accepted](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-m/) at each of Indiana's seven public colleges and universities.Braun's forward-thinking leadership has been a catalyst, spurring partnerships with higher education, business, and industry that will help prepare students for post-high school success. Indiana is investing [$7.5 million](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-c/) each year toward career coaching initiatives for students. Additionally, the state commits $10 million per year through [Career Scholarship Accounts](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-q/) for students in grades 10 through 12 to obtain career training. The account provides $5,000 per year that can be applied toward work-based learning expenses.The [Indiana Graduates Prepared to Succeed dashboard](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-a/), or Indiana GPS for short, [provides](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-f/) educators with key data points and parents with "meaningful, relevant, and transparent information about school progress and performance." [ILEARN](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-z/) is used to assess students three times during the school year for early and targeted intervention.Comprehensive and strategic [solutions](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-v/) focused on foundational skills, with a [$170 million investment](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-e/), have driven four consecutive years of rising student literacy rates. Fourth-grade Indiana student reading scores moved up to [sixth](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-s/) in the country in 2024 from [19th](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-g/) in 2022. Early elementary teachers are equipped with phonics-based science of reading practices. Additionally, [$1,000](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-w/) grants are awarded to families for student learning support. A key strategy is using [IREAD](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-yd/) in second grade to give parents and teachers an early "on track indicator" to gauge whether students will master foundational reading skills by the end of third grade. There is no wait-and-see approach.Building on a successful phonics initiative in early grades, Indiana is now targeting adolescent reading in grades six through eight, using outcomes-based contracts that pay vendors only when specific student outcomes are met. Math proficiency strategy and policy further set Indiana apart from the rest of the nation. [House Bill 1634](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-yh/) ensures educators use evidence-based instruction, implement math screening, and provide intensive support for students below grade level.Recognizing that the teacher is the number one school factor in student learning, the Indiana Department of Education rates teacher preparation programs for their alignment with the science of reading to provide transparency, ensure accountability, and incentivize improvement. Once on the job, top-performing teachers may be rewarded with stipends [up to $7,500](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-yk/).Indiana's bold and comprehensive strategy to advance K-12 education has set a new national benchmark for innovation, accountability, and student-centered reform. The Hoosier State isn't just participating in the education reform movement -- it's leading it, charting the course for the rest of the nation to follow.[Click Here to Read the Full Story](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-yu/) [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jl/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jr/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jy/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jj/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jt/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-ji/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W. OHIO ST., SUITE 2200 INDIANAPOLIS, IN 46204 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com [Preferences](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.updatemyprofile.com/y-qkhlidy-293A8D27-hhlljjcji-jh) | [Unsubscribe](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-u-qkhlidy-hhlljjcji-jk/)

| Peter,
Four years later we stand on the cusp of the second January 6th.
After the first attempt bottomed out, MAGA determined that their next coup would happen without ski masks and zip ties but rather within existing systems.
Today MAGA attempts a forced takeover of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court and god help us if we lose. If they take it, they control swing state Pennsylvania and their 19 electoral college votes for the next decade and beyond.
If they win, they ban abortion, redraw the maps, and we will never win an election here again, not in 2026 and not in 2028 where Trump has claimed he'll seek a third term. A coup in all but name.

The plans, still in early stages, would involve drone strikes and limited ground operations under intelligence authority, avoiding direct coordination with Mexico if necessary. President Trump has labeled cartels as terrorist groups, expanding legal authority for military action, and says law enforcement alone hasn’t stopped the flow of deadly drugs. Mexico’s President Claudia presence, though she’s allowed expanded CIA surveillance and border troop deployments. Officials insist the mission isn’t imminent but would mark a major shift from past U.S. policy. The push comes amid new threats against U.S. agents: a warned that cartels are offering $10,000 to shooters who target Border Patrol agents in the Rio Grande Valley in Texas. The alert says attackers may pose as Mexican soldiers and reflects rising cartel frustration. 50% of SNAP Benefits to Be Paid The Trump administration told a federal judge on Monday that it would to pay 50% of the normal Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits for November to the approximately 42 million Americans who receive food stamps. This decision came after U.S. District Court Judge Jack McConnell ordered the administration , although the administration declined to tap an additional $4 billion in emergency funds, known as Section 32 tariff revenue, stating that the money must be saved for child nutrition programs. This partial the SNAP contingency fund, leaving no cushion for new applicants, disaster assistance, or fully funding the program as long as the government shutdown continues. Kimberly-Clark Buys Tylenol Maker for $48.7B Kimberly-Clark announced Monday it is , Listerine, and Band-Aid, in a cash and stock deal valued at approximately $48.7 billion, creating a massive consumer health goods company. ## Texans Vote Today
Texans head to the polls today to vote on [17 proposed constitutional amendments](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGShCAQRL8GMywYUTAguMRsL73QGmRU6lC2lNX176_cX7hsarr6VXf_PPoHhhjW6RsXsvk9pn6lc4-UM209RRpySKvHa4xhmrOniNeOaw8Cai4lF6r3GOLVq8JbJ3wrC7JSNwC1bkxTzJYGPej7AdAqSaZx6HUt0MlKCT-KItgbJqVQEoSEqjSqAmeMB5LoWtUyJciHnLYyz5TpjfsYr3TQVg5pKaKdc37urPpi0DHozvMsf-f0ukUGHW45DJEYdHcvBt0zxZDDcJ8fFl_TQYujjSt-pBzWiU-v4G8HmJrj6F3bioobhyNXaBRHoQyvvAZftUBC18Vm_fMMMYa90UyJacEQP-Hy_yY9LPwFAAD__83AiE8) and several major local issues across the state. Statewide, [Proposition 16](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkM1uqzAQhZ_G7ILwYP4WXkSRssvVVVW1S8vGA4xkbArTJPTpK_IK3Z3NOfrO93kzN0uB4vjPzqj5OSQT8bEFZMbVYMCeKUVv9yHQOLHHYPfNRgMFVCcpT4Uy3lLYjcq8doXvZIZaNjVA1dRtnU3aV03ZOOi97bGqfCWVs0MrrbNu6FrVZ6SPMSkLJaGQUOatKsG1rQeU1nWqE6pAT5zWnCdkfNptCHu645r3ac6CnpiXTZRnAVcBV2dDSLygJ5undRRwfT8q5v-alrTRccfIWsDFXIjpB-M20WI-ElMczRt-fdOKM0Y25xmjfyUB7YEooMtW7ZcHhUBb3QhVjLOl8MLgv8m7a_gNAAD__5lDhjw) would amend the Texas Constitution to provide that "persons who are not citizens of the United States" cannot vote in Texas, echoing federal law but backed by Republicans as a voter integrity measure. [Proposition 14](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK2zAQhp9Gvm2QJrJsH3RY2gZ62LKUQo_D2BrHAlkK0jSbvH1x-wh7m8v3Md__-w3fKKaYrz9oZy-PtWDmj5ZYhCty4kViyYGea4rXTQInejbKCBr6F2NetMVAMT3RdsHPOkymY28GB9APbnTd5nmwq16m3iyu17ObrAu08MAUlnMfHHTRHzJjtDWgDZxPoz3DPI4B2NA82UlZzSFKqSfZWPhBbU3Pcud6WsreJb-J3Jo6vyq4KLjMlFKRG4dIp1KvCi6_DgTfa7mVFo8cNFbBF_zWhOYU24ZfeecskfC98v24SkbKAX9yY6rLht9zkyh_hLGs-N_3unMOB4YKxqNAwdRVH24fMaXY3KCsvu4U078v5XPb3j38DQAA__-UT5Hw) proposes a state-funded $3 billion institute for dementia research and treatment, drawing broad support despite concerns about long-term costs. [Proposition 4](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGKpDAURb8m7lqSVzHqIotiwF0PzUxDLx-JeWrgmYimq8u_H6xfmO2Fezn3fL3ju4sc0_zbrWTLc8qY6OdgKoV2JKaxxJyCOyeO81ICsTsPlxAkNG9KvUmNwUU-UVfBehl6VZFVrQFoWtOZarGtNmM_-qZvRwlN77sOSJEfZWu09sZU0V5jSkmtQCq41Z2-ge-6AKSc73UvtKQQS97rslChpzsmPvOD9nrMa8V2KWU7xO0uYBAweMecy0Yhujrvs4Dh86rgx563fMTrDmoBv_DOnEdXCD_y_krzhH8d04Gf7ol_6EHpm7Bk_HKXi-E7BbyvlMJKqaCA7sIW0Fe7DdtPZI6HaYWW8-oiv9DK_wl9WPgXAAD__1f4jM0) channels state sales tax revenue into a new Texas Water Fund to upgrade aging infrastructure amid drought and population growth. In Austin, [Proposition Q](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1ygzAQhU8jOjHSIvNTqEhD57QpmQUtRhMZYbQ2cPsMnsnkAKm_3Tfve1_X7oo--Pn2iXeyvI-xm2lLgZhp7SjQwD7ODo8x-NvEjgIeCecOFFyk1lKZzqEPR2cyZ3vlGp2R1VUJcKnKuswmq9WlKYuS3AjV2BQN4uCoH0HTUKuiMpm3Z5jWymhQGoq8NgX0de2ANPaNaYRR5DzHNeeJmHZMYzjii9Z8iPcs2Il5SaL4ENAKaLdty793nE8ooD1tBLRHfK4yxAGD_JWS0-M8n5ClT3JZ4xKTf4OHxGdiPyfJuMsVmf6eaF8C-pmcgDZbrVs2H4JPZSWMut3Rh3cp_t-ULws_AQAA__9oPYtI) looks to raise property taxes by $300 a year for the average homeowner to fund homelessness services, EMS staffing, parks, and public health.
## Kimberly-Clark to Acquire Tylenol Maker
Kimberly-Clark, based in Texas, announced Monday it will [acquire Kenvue](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQxfHTmA5kjw2GwsU2dNl2S-SPIVgZIIJJCLdfsVfY-km_J_1_bsPNZ8rL_dvP6PgzrsOCx07IjNuAhJHzuiR_jpTvEyckf-5-GUBCXSpVSjMkn-kcTJFckKlTBTplG4DaNm1TTE5bm5I2sfMdRu2VbGVTY7IA1ox10EV2F6aUNAqkAl21RkNo2wSofOhMJ4zElHndKp6Q8eP3kc71jVsV17kgNzE_d6G_BPQC-uM4qriEeI0C-ssW0CsloJdaQP_Ic8CNzjKS3x4lr2V4neUDl_cLq4lnKjaXnkcmyntjhZH32Wf6u-L_BXo7-A0AAP__zAx4lQ), the maker of Tylenol and Band-Aids, in a $48.7 billion cash and stock deal. The deal is expected to close in the second half of 2026, creating a [consumer goods giant](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u5CAQhE-Dsx5BG_8FBJuQvU03tMC0x2jbYBnmzfj2K-8VXlRSlfSp9P35mr9c5Jiev91Opn7WPCd6F6Za6ZyJaakxp-CuleNzq4HYXcWlGSV2oBRIPQcX-Zp1E4yXYVINGTX0iN3Qj32zmcGvnW6DkzT1elnagRbfd9MyjdSqsZNNNDdMKakVSoXtY9Qt-nEMSMr5SU9CSwqx5vNRN6r0cWXlK3_T-Vjy3rDZaj2KaH8JtAJtuo5c6j0JtDdZoFVKoJWtQOtfJSYqRaCtF1PKDH-ZKNEHvEsBXAxw555PguNV4ZUCnZATwZnzCjGBHmEAH5ljThDIsUDbnCYc77sr_SC0fO4u8v979WdSvw3-CwAA__8-B4qw) that will generate approximately $32 billion annually by combining Kimberly-Clark's well-known name brands, such as Huggies, Cottonelle, and Kleenex, with Kenvue's established brands. Kimberly-Clark will keep its headquarters in Irving. [Shareholders are set](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ_GdCB7cQwpXPwNXf72SrS218HKAjnshPD2J-4VrhtppBl939dtvGHitNz_40y2fOI6LrRnplJoG4nJl7QuAY_I6T6VQIxHxmUECZdaqVrqMWDiY9RVsE6Gq6rIqs4AXDrTm2qy4WJiG6RXsfNovHboYlRoXNd6VNhVyZ5jSkmtQCpom1634Po-ACl0V30VWlJIZd2aMlGhD-bIx_qmrfHrXLGdSnlm0f4TMAgY9n1vvMsnxdkLGM4oYHjQ8n5R_Uizo42P2jNujxr99yvldFLW5WBaVhYwVJsNzz0xp2w6oeV9xsS_d-Vvkt4WfgIAAP__pD5-Ww) to own about 54% of the combined entity, which is targeting $1.9 billion in cost savings over the next three years.
## Houston, Dallas Airports See Delays
Air travel across the U.S. [has been disrupted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp9GOwxcULSg-Bu7-dstDcIdJUGYyJ1xfPuNO_sG253kJif3fF-36WZDDGn5bzc09L7nKeFRIhLhPmFERyEnb897DMtKHqM9i00TcGiZEIyrydsQz0nV3szcD6JGI3QH0Oqu7-rV9FI7h5JbELPUWg625dpKrYbWaa2wDuaSCcGVAC5ANr2SMPe9BxR2HtRQKY4-UN4bWpHwbcs9nvmFe-PyVkezEj1KJf9VMFYwHsfRpNldFde9gvHCCsZnYb_0aWGfGPYIEdly-dKGiVhZn-TzkRgmwr2wgi4nz7acaGW7SxaUaLuh3o1_HCHGUDpdKb5sNsSfj-hvO74MfAcAAP__2eyJFg) as thousands of TSA agents and air traffic controllers work without pay amid the government shutdown. TSA wait times have reportedly exceeded three hours at Houston’s George Bush Intercontinental Airport. subject: November 2025
body:

#### Teichert in the Trenches - November 2025
Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs! ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/SIQ2Yu5PAKgj)
---
Secretary Hegseth’s meeting with Generals and Admirals continues to be a regular topic of conversation. This is one of the four interviews I did that day on this topic. (September 30th)
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/AYWxYlSFahf8)
---
This month wouldn’t be complete without providing one of the clips on our counter-cartel activities in the Western Hemisphere. Please note my two-time emphasis on the importance of informing and collaborating with Congress. (October 23rd)
[ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/ttEGnXwaJYjJ)
| | | And as a sample of other topics, here is a quick interview that includes Russia, Ukraine, Nuclear Weapons, Israel, and Gaza. Please note my pronunciation of the word “nuclear.” (IYKYK) (October 26th) ** _Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
| | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/ybb85xK0lVhH)
---
| | | Thanks to the Family Research Council for publishing my latest thoughts on our strategy with Putin and Russia! It’s time to break a cycle that is eroding our credibility and hindering our deterrence. (October 2nd)
---
| | | | [ "Smoke, Spoofing, and SAMs"](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdayNtB3m8v465R3Si/1_aq7SWMOtq1 "US absence in the world is as dangerous as US weakness")
---
| | | I thoroughly enjoyed writing this recent publication that took me back to my tactical roots. Thanks to Kelvin Hamilton and the amazing team at Flarebright Ltd. for providing a highly reliable, low-cost capability for contested environments around the world!
---
| | | | [ Social Stagnation and Risk Aversion](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGSV37CqMDvd0tOpPM2y/LUBr4v6JHg5q "Prayers for a Nation")
---
| | | 💥See this link for my thoughts on societal stagnation and risk aversion that has crept into our national cultural psyche! (related to The Fastest Man Ever – Pete Knight – October 3, 1967) 💥
---
| | | | [ Breaking the Barriers of Bureaucracy in 1947!](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/UToK8W30FIdV)
---
!!️ See these thoughts on how we all must aggressively extend our waiver authority to break barriers, challenge convention, and ignite innovation! (related to Chuck Yeager breaking the sound barrier on October 14, 1947)
| [ Clinton, Rice Discussion](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGgDxOqkiYEbCY0JLxDU/0EhpyYAQ_QU2)
---
| | | 🔥 🔥 🔥 Watch this for renewed hope in the American experiment – it provides what CAN BE in our political system! ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**
---

---
| |

| | |
---
| |

| | |
---
| |
---
| | | **_Behind the Scenes_**
---
| | | |
---
📚 Progress is going well on what is intended to be a powerful book describing the history and applicability of In God We Trust, alongside a stellar co-author in Pastor Brad Wells! It is tracking to be out in early 2026, perfectly in time to add to the celebration of our great nation’s 250th birthday!
⚓ The picture is from my favorite writing location – Kozy Beans coffee shop in Crofton, Maryland. And Go Navy, Beat Air Force!
| | | |
---
You’ll see a post above with a similar picture, but in retrospect I like this one better. I just thought I would share it with you.
|
---
A sample of pics from Team Teichert. Me getting a tour of Tiffany’s new police station at her internship.
|
---
On a fall hike with Summer in Utah (I did not pack enough warm clothes and had to borrow from Summer who is a huge OU gymnastics fan). I dumped the hat and wore the sweatshirt inside-out the rest of the trip to avoid the obvious questions about my sport’s allegiance.
|
---
Noah (who has rightfully moved up to the N position) is enjoying Vandy’s football dominance.
|
---
Mel and I at a Navy Women’s Volleyball game (she’s the faculty rep for the team and I may be a little overdressed).
**_My Bookshelf_**
|
---
From General Stan McChrystal: ”Lauren has an uncanny ability to break through government gridlock. This is partly because she is smart, but also because she can see the whole battlefield and plot multiple paths to complete the mission. She does the same in the nonprofit world and in her own personal life. In this book, she presents a vision of new pathways, adaptable skills, and forward thinking that meets resistance with formidable resolve.”
I also recorded a podcast with Lauren recently, and look forward to it being released in the next few months (I’ll include a link here when it does).
|
---
“Reputation management should never be delegated to specialists. Business leaders need to serve as reputation stewards. Reputation management needs to be integrated into a company’s strategy, organization, and culture.”
|
---
“So we must choose from among our Guardians those who appear to us on observation to be most likely to devote their lives to doing what they judge to be in the interest of the community, and who are never prepared to act against it.”
** _PLUS Posts for the Month_**
| | | |
---
| [ Lying Squared
(Oct 11th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGn5PXfhtiO5INJ3KFnk/zBf4QpeUsFrI "Pronouns Matter")
---
| [ Integrity First
(Oct 18th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGtwrgUf4sXZOCbnIYO0/GQXrq_8zSq1P "Finding the Stars")
---
| [ Concerns About Giants
(Oct 25th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDhYHcZvsAP4JMNKzgWGO/JiQLw_GtMN0r "We Must Listen")
---
| | | **_Blast from the Past_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE9szp0KEGKEZQCiofFyS/R4uRgoI3dkcd)
---
💥 It’s hard to believe that we launched our campaign for U.S. Senate 2 years ago (October 2nd, 2023). It was a wonderful start to wrestling our great nation back to where it belongs, and the best is yet to come!
| [ "Bringing Them Home"](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEcDi1QiaMFOpU26ddzgW/_E3ObGVm-b64)
---
I wrote these thoughts from my trip to Israel in February 2024, and that visit has come to my mind daily since then. We should all rejoice at the return of the living hostages and the beginning of the end of the war in Gaza! Now begins the long road of peace and recovery on both sides of the Gazan border, as we continue to await the return of all the slain hostages.
📣 In light of the current topics on the news, I dug up a part of my 2008 White House Fellow application. The prompt – write a relevant policy memo to the President of the United States. My policy – define criminal street gangs in the U.S. as terrorists. 17 years later, it is still relevant today.
💥 After an interview, I didn’t get selected for the program. Yet, it is powerful to consider that some policies are timeless.
**_Rejoin Opportunities_**
I will be busy with speaking engagements during the time around Veteran’s Day. If you are nearby any of these areas, please join us:Mukwonago Baptist Church (Mukwonago, WI) – 7 NovemberValley Forge Baptist Church (Collegeville, PA) – 9 NovemberFirst Baptist Hammond (Hammond, IN) – 16 November
** _Dad Joke of the Month_**
I visited Utah a few weeks ago and got invited to an archeology party where they were unearthing the world’s largest dinosaur tibia.
It was a huge shindig!
| | | |
---
| | | | **Teichert in the Trenches**

| Washington, DC

Hey Derek,
**It’s Election Day in PA,** and I’m checking in personally to make sure you have a plan to vote. If you need to check your voter registration or find your polling place, start here. 👇

---
Three Supreme Court justices are on the ballot in critical retention elections. Voters decide if they stay or go.
State Supreme Courts rule on huge issues, from **redistricting and reproductive rights to election laws, trans rights, and environmental protections.**
And today’s stakes couldn’t be higher: Republicans are trying to flip seats in their favor. If they flip even one seat, we risk gerrymandered maps, abortion bans, and attacks on voting rights.
So here’s what to do right now:
**✅ Make a plan to vote – or drop off your mail-in ballot.**
**✅ Bring a friend or neighbor with you – every vote counts.**
✅ **VOTE YES to retain the justices and judges on your ballot.**
**REMEMBER: Polls are open until 8pm, and mail-in ballots have to be received by your county election office by 8 PM – no later.**
Democracy only works when we all show up. Get to the polls today, and cast your ballot like our future depends on it – because it does. 🇺🇸🗳️
John ❤️

# Paxton Defends Medical Freedom on All Fronts
---
| |
---
| Attorney General Ken Paxton continues to take bold action to defend Texas families against corporate corruption and manipulation of consumers. In October alone, he took **powerful action** against the medical mafia four times. First, AG Paxton [called out](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTcwMTQ0MTUyNjY2NzY4NjQ2LFwiclwiOjE3MDE0NDE5NDQ1ODgxNDA3NH0iLCJzIjoiZDZiOWYxN2RlMWQwYzFiMCJ9) the **Texas Medical Association** for quietly expanding its vaccine guidance beyond federal recommendations, sidestepping informed consent and parental choice. This is the same TMA that has worked tirelessly to defeat medical liberty bills in the Legislature, oftentimes testifying in favor of limiting choice and denying patients’ rights. In his next bold move, Paxton secured [an agreement](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTcwMTQ0MTUyNjc0MTA4NjkxLFwiclwiOjE3MDE0NDE5NDQ1ODgxNDA3NH0iLCJzIjoiOWY4NTgwNGI5YjNiOTZjNCJ9) with Austin Diagnostic Clinic after it blocked parents from viewing their children’s health records after age 12. Thanks to his intervention, Texas parents will once again have **full access to their children’s medical information** , marking an essential victory for transparency and informed consent. Additionally, Paxton is upholding recently passed legislation by [demanding answers](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTcwMTQ0MTUyNjgyNDk3MzAyLFwiclwiOjE3MDE0NDE5NDQ1ODgxNDA3NH0iLCJzIjoiNGUzZDVhMGIyMmQwZTkzNSJ9) from Houston Methodist Hospital after reports surfaced that the hospital system **denied transplants to unvaccinated patients**. He cited HB 4076, now law, which prohibits discrimination based on vaccination status in life-saving care since no Texan should ever be forced to choose between freedom and survival. And just last week, Paxton announced that he has [filed suit](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTcwMTQ0MTUyNjg3NzQwMTg1LFwiclwiOjE3MDE0NDE5NDQ1ODgxNDA3NH0iLCJzIjoiZDljYzc0NGRiZTJmYzY5MyJ9) against Johnson & Johnson and Kenvue, accusing them of **hiding known risks** of prenatal Tylenol exposure. The case seeks justice for families misled by deceptive marketing and echoes TFVC’s call for Big Pharma accountability. **From protecting your right to access records to challenging medical mandates, TFVC is excited to see these fights for freedom advancing on every front, and we thank AG Ken Paxton for leading the way!**

That's huge -- and it's proof that our organizing is working. But before we celebrate, here's the truth: today will decide everything. In 2020, we saw what's called the "red mirage." Republicans looked strong early on because same-day votes were counted first, while Democrats' mail ballots were counted later. This year, it could be the opposite -- a "blue mirage." The early vote looks great, but MAGA voters are expected to flood polling places today. Over 3 million Pennsylvanians are expected to cast ballots in total. That means 2 million+ votes are still up for grabs right now. That's why today's effort, these final few hours, matters more than any other day in this entire election. Defend Our Courts is on the ground across Pennsylvania making sure every Democrat gets to the polls -- fueling canvass teams, keeping our organizers moving, and powering ads to drive turnout until the last poll closes. body:

| Peter,
This is it.
Today, Pennsylvania's ultra-critical Supreme Court race is Ground Zero in the fight against Trump's demented attack on our rights--a chance to send an unmistakable signal to the country and to the world that we won't let MAGA destroy our country.
If Trump wins today, he will be fully in control of PA's future: with a total abortion ban looming on the horizon and his cadre of billionaires ready to dismantle PA just like the White House East Wing: piece by piece, brick by brick.
The state's richest man, Jeff Yass, has been preparing for the moment he will be able to own the courts. He recently plunked down at least $2.5 million for Trump's corrupt WH Ballroom to curry favor with Trump ahead of the results of this election:

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XrqnSz0NCMtENXwhPJatRItLz4XeNJjnuCREtzCPPrfYNuOj7qKqSJH07W7i5V2dZWekRNkUJ1zxXaj_wRD9edtGt3tqRmhJUa_-pk-WjGLolnp9boZQGJvRdFM_3Z7WDP9m_vBHDUq9i8hKyTuHKwePtBEMBkauu7gEVkT_0tWfpXYcUX77nP_eWh90zildVExrhhfzvUxIkupte4hI2MGz3gyF9iyozIDs-TN6PpI=&c=-G0ZztthawP7wLr7ywX5GXx8SeLGQJjBA1gP7xBREfYyjiSi8xEC_A==&ch=KUEiFTG5XLFVbkYBfiWqvxjeUxE3osWiPeFWinva50hHdpzExNafTA==)

Because if MAGA is allowed to run up the score on Election Day in-person voting, they can swamp all Dem mail-in ballots and win in places we once thought impossible -- including many blue precincts in Philly.
If we don't leave everything on the field, the future of Pennsylvania and thus our nation could look a lot like the corrupt Trump White House Ballroom: owned by billionaires, operated by Trump.
[Will you chip in any amount right now to keep our boots on the ground until polls close tonight at 8 PM Eastern? name: Chairman Eugene DePasquale
subject: Your vote matters, polls open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Pennsylvania Democratic Party
body:
| |
---
Friend,

Today is your day. The chance to shape Pennsylvania’s future is here, and all you have to do is show up and vote.

Polls are open **from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.** across the Commonwealth.

If you’re already in line at 8 p.m., you’re still entitled to vote, so don’t leave early.

Here’s what matters:
* If you’re voting in person, go to your polling place, **bring whatever ID you need** , and make your voice heard.
* If you requested a mail-in or absentee ballot, **it must be received by 8 p.m. today** at your county election office in order to be counted.

name: Kelly McKenna, End Chronic Disease
subject: What’s wrong with kids today?
body:
Chronic disease is the number one most urgent crisis our country faces, and ultra-processed foods are a leading cause of this crisis.
---
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1284523/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVkIyUVpqRkR3eQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTExMDQ/LbmNsamtCUzdLbQ/qP2hpZHM9bmN4MUJ0WVdlaGJCQU5scw/gaQoQ6A/s8n0a2ba1b9)
| | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | |

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
Friend,

Chronic disease is the number one most urgent crisis our country faces, and ultra-processed foods are a leading cause of this crisis.

These foods, **which often lack any meaningful nutritional value and are engineered to be addictive** , have been shown by peer-reviewed science to cause a number of chronic diseases, such as:
* Diabetes
* Obesity
* Heart disease
* Fatty liver disease
* Cancer

And yet, these foods continue to permeate our grocery shelves, our pantries, and our schools.

**American children get an estimated 70% of their daily calories from ultra-processed foods, and much of this is coming from the foods they eat in schools!**

We won’t survive as a nation if we don’t come together to address this health crisis.

**At End Chronic Disease (ECD), this is our sole mission.**

ECD played a pivotal role in passing one of the most bipartisan pro-health bills in California's history. This bill, Assembly Bill 1264, made California the first state in the nation to legally define ultra-processed foods and begin phasing the worst of them out of schools.

This is just the beginning.

**End Chronic Disease is on the front lines, advocating for reform to address this crisis directly through public policy at the state level and promoting public empowerment through media, storytelling, and education nationwide.**

[You can help us reverse America’s chronic disease crisis by donating today!](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[Donate Now >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
The good news is that chronic diseases are largely lifestyle-driven and preventable.

I have personally battled chronic autoimmune issues for more than twenty years and have been able to clinically reverse a number of these through preventive health measures and dietary and lifestyle interventions.

An easy win in the fight against chronic illness is identifying and addressing how ultra-processed foods intensify this crisis.

**Ultra-processed foods aren’t just unhealthy – they’re engineered for overconsumption, shaped by the same strategies that once hooked people on cigarettes!**

End Chronic Disease is committed to reversing America’s chronic disease crisis through science-based, prevention-first education, advocacy, and collaboration. By driving systems change and amplifying real success stories, we empower individuals to take control of their health — and build a stronger, healthier nation.

[You can help ensure that future generations benefit from policies that drive systemic change and foster a healthy, thriving society by donating to End Chronic Disease today. >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Best,

**Kelly McKenna**
CEO, End Chronic Disease
