subject: The retirement talk most people do NOT have
body:
| Hi Peter, How often are you talking about retirement? And when you do, how much of that focuses on creating a plan that works in real life, not just on paper? For many, the answer is "not enough."1 In fact, about 44% of people are not talking about retirement finances at all.1 This can make it easy to miss the costs and life changes that could affect your savings.
---
|
---
The good news is that identifying those expenses early gives you more options and more time to prepare. That is exactly what we are covering in this month's Visual Insights Newsletter. [Go ahead and click here to see what to watch for and how to protect your nest egg.](https://financeinsights.net/KXlgTVr7Lf0GlmpiQWL3qsg726b?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Sincerely,

**Reid Rasner - CEO**

subject: Americans are suffering, while Democrats are more concerned with White House Construction
disclaimer_text: Paid for by David Flippo for Nevada]( "Paid for by David Flippo for Nevada")

| | [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=3744903871&e=273c9a71fb)

| | Patriot,

While our nation’s heroes and federal workers are going without pay, **Democrat politicians are more concerned with White House renovations than ending the government shutdown.**

As the government shutdown continues to drag on, Democrats are picking the wrong side of every 80-20 issue. Currently, our service members and federal employees are worried about how they will afford groceries or pay their mortgage, **but Democrats are more concerned with President Trump’s White House renovations. The citizens of Nevada’s 4th Congressional District deserve to know that their Congressman is focused on serving them in Washington, not political showmanship!**
---
| [TELL DEMOCRATS TO FOCUS ON ENDING THE SHUTDOWN](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=1ef5f63c02&e=273c9a71fb "TELL DEMOCRATS TO FOCUS ON ENDING THE SHUTDOWN")

| Democrats in Washington are currently involved in one of the most tone-deaf political displays our country has seen. While they are focused on the White House construction, they continue to gaslight the American people, claiming Republicans are to blame for the shutdown. Not to mention, **Democrats in the Senate have now rejected ANOTHER clean continuing resolution. **
When I'm in Congress, I'll fight for my constituents because I believe that Congressmembers should serve their constituents, not use them in their political games! The Nevadans of our district will be sending me to Washington to work for them, not participate in political stunts.

In order to do this, we have to defeat Steven Horsford! **Will you chip in to my campaign so that NV-04 can have a Congressman who does their job in Washington?**

We have a real opportunity to bring real, positive, conservative change to Nevada, but it will take all of us working together. **I am matching every single dollar that is being donated, so your donation will have 2X the impact! Will you join our movement to flip NV-04?**

body:
| | | It’s here. **Election Day.** The air feels different, doesn’t it? That quiet hum — of hope, of urgency, of something about to happen. For months, we’ve knocked on doors, stood in the rain, shared stories on porches and sidewalks and front lawns. We’ve talked about what kind of Virginia we want — one where every family has a fair shot, where freedom means something real, and where compassion is strength, not weakness. Our signs have been torn down, the attack ads have flown, but our movement never wavered. We kept showing up — together — because we believe in something bigger than politics: **a Virginia that works for everyone.** So take a deep breath. Grab your coffee. Lace up your shoes. **_And go vote_****.** **If you haven’t voted yet, go now. Bring a friend. Text your cousin. Text five more. Post that “I Voted” selfie. Let’s make sure every voice is heard.** This campaign has always been about you — about working families, about freedom, about community. And today, we get to prove what people power looks like when it rises up, loud and proud. No matter what happens tonight, I couldn’t be prouder of what we’ve built together. You’ve turned hope into action, and action into a movement. So lace up your shoes, grab your coffee, and let’s go make history. **This is our day. This is Virginia’s day. Let’s go win it.** — Elizabeth Guzman **P.S.** Polls in Virginia are open until 7PM! clean_body: | | | It’s here. Election Day. The air feels different, doesn’t it? That quiet hum — of hope, of urgency, of something about to happen. For months, we’ve knocked on doors, stood in the rain, shared stories on porches and sidewalks and front lawns. We’ve talked about what kind of Virginia we want — one where every family has a fair shot, where freedom means something real, and where compassion is strength, not weakness. Our signs have been torn down, the attack ads have flown, but our movement never wavered. We kept showing up — together — because we believe in something bigger than politics: a Virginia that works for everyone. So take a deep breath. Grab your coffee. Lace up your shoes. And go vote. If you haven’t voted yet, go now. Bring a friend. Text your cousin. Text five more. Post that “I Voted” selfie. Let’s make sure every voice is heard. This campaign has always been about you — about working families, about freedom, about community. And today, we get to prove what people power looks like when it rises up, loud and proud. No matter what happens tonight, I couldn’t be prouder of what we’ve built together. You’ve turned hope into action, and action into a movement. So lace up your shoes, grab your coffee, and let’s go make history. This is our day. This is Virginia’s day. Let’s go win it. — Elizabeth Guzman P.S. Polls in Virginia are open until 7PM! Illinois State Senator Jason Plummer (R, Dist. 55). (Jason Plummer official website)
By Illinois Review

Thousands of Illinoisans gathered this weekend to honor the Bailey family after the tragic helicopter crash that claimed the lives of former State Senator and gubernatorial candidate Darren Bailey’s son, daughter-in-law, and two young grandchildren.

The outpouring of love was overwhelming. The line to greet the Bailey family stretched for hours – some waiting more than four hours to pay their respects. Even Gov. JB Pritzker and First Lady MK Pritzker quietly attended on Sunday, a rare moment of bipartisan compassion.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/11/baileys-own-state-senator-jason-plummer-skips-family-memorial-as-thousands-mourn.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6b52c4b106-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
(Darren Bailey)
But while Democrats showed up, several top Illinois Republicans did not. Among them was State Sen. Jason Plummer, the Senate Republican Deputy Leader – and the Bailey family’s own elected representative.

Plummer’s absence stunned conservatives across southern Illinois, who expected him to stand shoulder to shoulder with his grieving constituents.His no-show comes as he faces increasing scrutiny for his political and business entanglements.

The Plummer family is a minority owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers, a Major League Baseball franchise that has repeatedly angered conservatives by celebrating transgender athletes and drag performers during “Pride Night.”

On Saturday, the Dodgers won the World Series in Toronto.

And as campaign chairman for Ted Dabrowski’s gubernatorial campaign, Plummer has been at the center of growing controversy. Dabrowski’s campaign has been dogged by infighting, tone-deaf messaging, and a lack of grassroots connection – problems many trace back to the same out-of-touch leadership now embodied by Plummer.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/11/baileys-own-state-senator-jason-plummer-skips-family-memorial-as-thousands-mourn.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6b52c4b106-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Dabrowski for governor campaign chairman Jason Plummer speaking at Dabrowski’s campaign announcement. (The Center Square/screenshot)
Adding to the frustration, both House GOP Leader Tony McCombie and Deputy Leader Norine Hammond – who also skipped the service – voted earlier this year to expand transgender patient rights, a move conservatives say betrays core party values.

But for many downstate Republicans, it was Plummer’s absence that hurt the most.

At a time of unimaginable grief, his failure to show up for one of his own constituents – one who has carried the banner for conservative values across the state – spoke volumes.

In politics, words about faith and family are easy. Showing up when it matters most is harder. Jason Plummer’s absence was noticed – and quietly, deeply felt.

Peter,
The New York Times has confirmed what we’ve known all along: AIPAC’s grip on Washington is starting to slip, and our movement is right at the center of it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-25q4?refcode=x_251104_DemsvAipac_act]

Last year, they spent more than $23 million to defeat Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, two of the loudest progressive voices standing up against unconditional U.S. aid to Netanyahu’s government. They didn’t just come for Cori’s seat. They came for our movement.
But the article makes it clear that something has changed.
Public opinion is shifting. Democratic voters no longer give unconditional support to Netanyahu’s far-right government. Members of Congress, even establishment Democrats who once relied on AIPAC’s money, are walking away, rethinking their ties.
And why? Because of voices like Cori’s, voices that refused to back down, even when the cost was enormous.
Even though the outcome wasn’t what we wanted, Cori’s loss wasn’t the end, it was only the beginning. The crack in the glass shattering their grip on the Democratic party and our democracy.
Now it’s time to finish the work we started, to take that crack and turn it into a break wide enough to let democracy breathe. The movement she built, the one you are part of, is alive. It’s growing. And it’s needed now more than ever.
That’s why we’re asking you, right now: will you chip in whatever you can today to keep building the kind of movement money can’t buy? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-25q4?refcode=x_251104_DemsvAipac_act]

body:
Read to the end for one way we can all help.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118644979/580419179/1239926708?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_Newsletter_110425&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzQxYjY1MS05N2I5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=neW-nSbKa3_ceqNtYyEMD4COQesZsxWVAuI7iBM0jG8=&emci=8daf9a52-04b9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=e741b651-97b9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520) Friend, earlier this month, I visited the Weld County Food Bank. What I saw in Greeley, on my Fight for Colorado tour, reminded me _exactly_ why I’m in this fight. Read on to learn what we’ve been up to, and jump to the end for ways to take action with us on hunger in our state.
* * *
**Fighting for SNAP and food security** No one in Colorado should have to choose between food, housing, or medicine. **That’s why I’ve taken the Secretary of Agriculture to court.** The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) initially refused to tap into an emergency reserve of funds specifically designated for Supplemental Nutritional Assistance Program (SNAP) recipients. **Their goal was to cut off SNAP benefits on November 1st. Their actions have put 42 million people — including more than 600,000 Coloradans — at risk of a broader hunger crisis.** And our farmers, ranchers, producers, and every person who plays a role in our food systems will be harmed by this wrongful action. We are holding the Agriculture Secretary and the Trump administration accountable for their illegal and harmful actions — and have secured relief that will limit the damage. The administration will be required to tap into a reserve fund it initially refused to use, but those funds only provide partial relief, and the administration is opting not to use other funds that could provide critical food assistance and are leaving people vulnerable. This is actually the _second_ time I have taken the USDA to court for unlawful actions that hurt families who depend on SNAP’s nutrition assistance. **My promise to you is this: Every time they try to break the law, I will be there to hold them accountable.**
* * *
**One action we can all take today to fight hunger** In Greeley, I met with Bob O’Connor and his incredible Weld County Food Bank team, who work every day to make sure families don’t go hungry. They’ve expanded their hours into the evenings so that working parents can get food after long shifts. **If you share my belief that no Coloradan should ever go hungry, I’m asking for your help today.** Please join me and consider donating and/or volunteering with some of the incredible organizations leading this work across our state: | | [Weld County Food Bank](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118644991/580419197/-1965312970?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_Newsletter_110425&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzQxYjY1MS05N2I5LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=neW-nSbKa3_ceqNtYyEMD4COQesZsxWVAuI7iBM0jG8=&emci=8daf9a52-04b9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=e741b651-97b9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)

| Peter,
There are less than 4 hours until polls close in today's Pennsylvania State Supreme Court race and it is still anyone's game. If MAGA seizes this court Dems never win PA again.
Democrats were poised for a massive comeback victory until Trump intervened on Sunday night and flipped the race on its head.
To stabilize the situation and blunt the impact of Trump's final push, Defend our Courts took a dangerous gamble. We wagered our entire war chest on a massive final round of ads and text messages under the notion that we could recoup it last night and today.
We didn't and now we are out of money.
We needed to raise a minimum of $150k today to become solvent again. We are halfway there but donations have drastically fallen off over the last hour.

This race could be decided by thousands if not hundreds of votes. We need to get back on track towards recouping our budget and get these canvassing shifts back on today's schedule.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. name: Jim Schultz
subject: Are Minnesotans Better Off Than We Were Seven Years Ago?
body:
Minnesota once led the nation—but after seven years of Tim Walz, we’ve fallen behind. Jim Schultz explains what went wrong and how to fix it.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/23f75a97c022/the-briefing-from-mpbc-13057532?e=baf210d431)
---
| | | | |
---
| | Friend,
I’ve been thinking a lot about something Ronald Reagan asked in 1980: _“Are you better off than you were four years ago?”_ Americans answered “no” then, and Reagan was swept into the presidency and Jimmy Carter ushered out.
It’s a simple question—but a powerful one. And it’s one every Minnesotan should be asking today, as I write in my column for the [_**Duluth News Tribune**_](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=c890590a91&e=baf210d431)**.**
After seven years of Tim Walz as governor, I think most people—across party lines—would quietly admit the same thing: **no, we’re not better off.**
**The Economy** Minnesota used to be one of the strongest and most stable economies in America. Now we’ve fallen behind.
For the first time, our **GDP per person has dropped below the national average.** And job growth here has been less than half the national rate.
And after a record $19 billion surplus—the largest in state history—our government managed to drive the state into a **$6 billion deficit.**
That doesn’t happen by accident. It’s a **reflection of poor priorities and even poorer management.**
**Education, Safety, Fraud** Education tells a similar story.
**Less than half of Minnesota students are proficient** in math or reading—roughly ten points lower than when Governor Walz took office. Despite billions more in spending, **our kids are learning less.**
These aren’t just numbers; they represent **real children falling behind,** and a future workforce that won’t have the skills to compete.
Public safety isn’t doing better either. **Violent crime remains far above 2018 levels.**
**And of course there is massive fraud in our state.** The _Feeding Our Future_ scandal—**one of the largest cases of government fraud in the nation** —illustrates what happens when a single-party operates without accountability or common sense.
When you spend more, you owe people more accountability. **That hasn’t happened here.**

I wrote about this in more detail in my column for the _Duluth News Tribune_.[**Read the column here**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=675176ba18&e=baf210d431)
**The Wrong Priorities** What’s most frustrating is where the governor’s focus has been.
**Free college and health care for illegal immigrants.** Driver’s licenses without verification. Radical social **priorities like boys in girls' sports that divide instead of unite.**
Meanwhile, families are struggling to pay for groceries, feel safe in their neighborhoods, and make sure their kids are learning the basics.
**We need to get back to the fundamentals:** work, accountability, safe streets, good schools, and a healthy economy. These aren’t partisan goals—they’re the foundation of a strong and hopeful state.
**A Path Forward** Minnesota has every reason to be great again. We have the people, the resources, and the values to lead. What we need now is focus—and **leadership that measures success by outcomes, not press releases**.
That’s the case I make in my new column, _“Is Minnesota Better Off Than It Was Seven Years Ago?”_
I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read it and share it with friends who care about where our state is headed.[**Read the column here**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=bd1cc98424&e=baf210d431)
Working with you,
**Jim Schultz** PresidentMinnesota Private Business Council

| Peter,
There are less than 4 hours until polls close in today's Pennsylvania State Supreme Court race and it is still anyone's game. If MAGA seizes this court Dems never win PA again.
Democrats were poised for a massive comeback victory until Trump intervened on Sunday night and flipped the race on its head.
To stabilize the situation and blunt the impact of Trump's final push, Defend our Courts took a dangerous gamble. We wagered our entire war chest on a massive final round of ads and text messages under the notion that we could recoup it last night and today.
We didn't and now we are out of money.
We needed to raise a minimum of $150k today to become solvent again. We are halfway there but donations have drastically fallen off over the last hour.

subject: Peter, is your ballot in yet? It’s Election Day!
body:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/55397A547331437756523633393372733448446D57645878786949434A7135577074414B3137743374756E6E6D2F413075366D756361372B3470544B506B6858/editor_images/11425%20Election%20Day%20-%20email%20header%20%281%29.png]
Hi Peter,
It’s Election Day! There may be an election happening in your area today — you can check that here [https://sos.oregon.gov/voting/Pages/current-election.aspx] , — and today is your last chance to make sure your ballot is counted.
There are two ways to return your ballot:
1. Drop your ballot off in person at the post office! Hand it to an attendant and make sure it’s postmarked by today (November 4th).
2. Use an official dropbox [https://sos.oregon.gov/voting/Pages/drop-box-locator.aspx] ! As long as you are in line at an official dropbox location by 8pm today (November 4th), your ballot will be accepted.
For any questions you may have about voting, take a look at our Voter Resources here [https://www.olcv.org/2025-voter-resources/] . If you need assistance voting or have further questions, contact your county elections office here [https://sos.oregon.gov/elections/Pages/countyofficials.aspx] .
The clock is ticking, so get out now and drop your ballot off in person at the post office or at a dropbox by 8pm tonight. Your voice is more important than ever, no matter how big or small the election, during times like these. Please take part in our democracy and get your ballot in!
Happy voting,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]

Fellow American,

My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. **I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. _This is my story._**

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do.

I maintain, without a shadow of a doubt, that my story is only possible in America. I am the second most powerful person in the former capital of the Confederacy, and I am a black female. _I am the epitome of the boundless opportunity and freedom that can _**only**_ be found in America.__**But Fellow American, my story is far from over.**_ I'm running for Governor not only to break records but also to continue spreading my conservative message - to show the world that a black, female, immigrant - and anyone else for that matter - can go from absolutely nothing to the highest levels of American politics. This is my story.| | | | Fellow American, My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. This is my story. In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do. Before becoming the 2nd in command in Virginia, I beat a 20-year incumbent in 2001 to become the first Republican to win a seat in a majority black district in the Virginia House of Delegates since 1865. In the General Assembly, I focused on getting results for my constituents. Prior to my career in politics, I had the distinct honor of serving as an electrician in the United States Marine Corps. It was here that I learned to be a leader--to improvise, adapt, and overcome. Looking back, my time in the Marines had a significant impact on who I am today, and for that, I'm ever grateful. Looking even further back, when I was just 6 years old, my family and I came to the United States from Jamaica. We arrived in a new land with no money and different accents, but we made it work and got through the struggles - only in America is something like this even possible. Of course, none of this would have been possible without my husband, Terence, and my amazing daughters. Throughout all of this, they have been my rock, and I owe them everything - they have kept me grounded, confident, and optimistic for the future. As you can see, I've lived a full life. There have been highs, lows, and everything in between, but I don't regret a single thing. I maintain, without a shadow of a doubt, that my story is only possible in America. I am the second most powerful person in the former capital of the Confederacy, and I am a black female. I am the epitome of the boundless opportunity and freedom that can only be found in America.But Fellow American, my story is far from over. I'm running for Governor not only to break records but also to continue spreading my conservative message - to show the world that a black, female, immigrant - and anyone else for that matter - can go from absolutely nothing to the highest levels of American politics. Now, the support I have received for my campaign thus far has been amazing, but the reality is that if we 're going to have a shot at winning this thing, then we must be well-funded. Last week, the centrist advocacy group WelcomePAC released "[Deciding to Win](https://substack.com/redirect/0435d3bf-78b0-44c7-bc93-2dba1da37ed2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," a 59-page memo purporting to analyze what has gone wrong with the Democratic Party and what changes will allow the party to step back from the electoral abyss.
Coming from a [billionaire-funded](https://substack.com/redirect/7f798d15-a45d-40e6-a33b-3eec4ddfc706?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) interest group whose founder wears a [Joe Manchin sports jersey](https://substack.com/redirect/5edaca4c-8069-4b5a-bd06-fdf83d67b250?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it's unsurprising that the report concludes that the Democratic Party should swerve to the right. More specifically, it argues that "Democrats need to affirmatively moderate our positions" on issues like "climate change, democracy, abortion, and identity and cultural issues"--not just in our communications but also "in our approach to governance."
To its credit, the WelcomePAC report does not try to defend the full panoply of centrist economic and political doctrines. It accepts that "large swaths of the electorate think the system is rigged against people like them in favor of the wealthy," a fact that is obvious but has been [contested](https://substack.com/redirect/5482846b-5d53-4286-9559-d40091c7f468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by WelcomePAC's centrist forebears. And the report clarifies that WelcomePAC's definition of moderation does not mean reflexively defending "the political establishment, elites, corporate interests, or the status quo." For many years, this is, of course, _precisely_ what "moderate" has meant in the Democratic Party. But groups like WelcomePAC feeling compelled to say that Democratic fealty to corporations is an electoral problem shows that the populist left is winning the narrative battle within the party. The left should take the W.
Beyond this basic concession, however, "Deciding to Win" is a tendentious mess. Its methodologies are shoddy and biased, its representations are deceptive, its strategic advice is often counterproductive, and its recommendations--which include giving up on the fight for a livable future for humanity--are in many cases morally reprehensible.

For starters, many of WelcomePAC's claims are based on a [metric](https://substack.com/redirect/95fc32e2-7477-419f-899b-2e2adae3bcb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) developed by a centrist data analyst outfit called Split Ticket, which argues that moderate Congressional candidates are much stronger electoral performers than progressive candidates. Social scientists Adam Bonica and Jake Grumbach did a [deep dive](https://substack.com/redirect/cdcfd9b6-8ec3-45ce-9ccf-60137738bc13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into Split Ticket's system and found its core findings are based on "a biased metric, constructed in a way that makes moderates look good and progressives look bad." Essentially, Split Ticket's formula takes the standard comparison between a Democratic candidate's vote share and the Democratic presidential nominee's vote share in the same district, and then adds a bunch of proprietary "adjustments." These adjustments account for more than two-thirds of the candidate's score. As Bonica and Grumbach argue, "This gives Split Ticket a ton of leeway to stack the deck in favor of moderates."
More transparent models, by comparison, have found that moderates receive [no vote share advantage](https://substack.com/redirect/cdcfd9b6-8ec3-45ce-9ccf-60137738bc13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or only a [modest advantage](https://substack.com/redirect/c20e5179-5433-49b6-bcc0-7c090cf5f369?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) relative to progressives. Democrats should not be basing their electoral and governance strategy on a set of black-box "adjustments" from an ideologically motivated centrist outfit, particularly one whose founder [admitted](https://substack.com/redirect/6a2ccc1f-3bd1-4d19-8a2a-c57b837c3dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that he designed a presentation of polling about Zohran Mamdani "precisely to push back against the idea" that Democrats should look to Zohran as a model.
"Deciding to Win" asks for the same blind faith regarding its polling methodologies. The report declares that issue polling "conducted by advocacy groups"--though not centrist ones like WelcomePAC--"substantially overstates support for liberal policies." Its evidence is a [study](https://substack.com/redirect/eb317db3-e956-4d14-b3c5-8f13b646bb29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showing that sky-high polling on an issue does not generally translate to similarly sky-high electoral results for ballot initiatives.
It's true that in a profoundly polarized political system like ours, public opinion on an issue will take a hit once it enters the partisan gauntlet of an election. But is that really enough to justify WelcomePAC's claim that "traditional issue polling is broken" and that we should instead trust their--arguably [extremely biased](https://substack.com/redirect/a22da597-7b18-4de5-bcc2-8f3d81ed9696?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--polling methodology, selection of issues, and language and framing choices?
That's a huge leap, particularly when WelcomePAC's results contradict so many other surveys. For example, "Deciding to Win" claims "foreign policy issues are of low importance to voters, with 'War in the Middle East' ranking as the 30th most important issue to the electorate." Compare that to [polling](https://substack.com/redirect/0c8fc0c1-2b74-48e3-87ea-14ed683d3304?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) earlier this year finding that, among voters who supported Joe Biden in 2020 but failed to turn out in 2024, the number one reason they cited, above the economy and immigration, was Gaza--which seems like relevant information for a party plotting its path forward.
Further undermining the notion that "Deciding to Win" deserves the benefit of the doubt are the report's many claims that are simply not justified by the evidence presented. The report fails to provide compelling evidence even for its most foundational premise--that the Democratic Party has, in fact, lurched far to the left.
For example, the report tries to connect Biden's unpopularity to the perception that he "governed from the left" by pointing to a poll at the end of Biden's term that reported a larger share of voters saw Biden as "too liberal" than several polls at the beginning of his term. And maybe a centrist pundit could argue that the shift took place because Biden moved to the left. But that person should at least contend with the other argument: that it happened because Republicans relentlessly shouted that Biden was a communist (as they always do), and the public never got an effective counter-narrative from an enfeebled president or a wildly [incompetent](https://substack.com/redirect/926476c9-45a4-4e0b-aee3-f1ff2f7f3896?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) White House press shop.
The report likewise points to the increased prevalence of select words in the Democratic Party's 2024 platform versus its 2012 platform. Again, maybe there's some connection (though a relatively weak one) between a party's official platform and its actual campaigning and governance strategies--but can we really draw much meaning from Democrats mentioning the word "justice" 0.54 per 1,000 words more in 2024 than 2012, or "child care" 0.42 more, or "environmental justice" 0.13 more, but "father," "responsibility," and "work" 0.23, 0.34, and 0.5 less?
There are dozens of points like this in "Deciding to Win." One section of the report titled "The Myth of Mobilization" attempts to refute the idea that Democrats can increase their vote share by prioritizing base mobilization, but cites in _support_ of this argument a [study](https://substack.com/redirect/f696b839-0644-47a7-b941-2347211f8509?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) finding that "turnout was a fundamental part of the explanation for the outcome in [the 2020 presidential election]" because new voters and third-party switchers to a major party were more likely to favor "greater government involvement in healthcare" and hold "liberal views on immigration.
At no point in this report does WelcomePAC discuss the key to Donald Trump's electoral victories. Doing so would've highlighted the larger deficiencies of the report. Working-class voters didn't swing to Trump because they agreed with him on every issue. They voted for him, because they [believed he would take a wrecking ball](https://substack.com/redirect/cd89c750-810c-4638-b971-db765ea02393?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a system that, in the minds of many working-class voters, needs to be demolished. Once a politician has defined themself this way--or defined their party, as is the case to some degree with Trump's MAGA-fied GOP--then voters who are looking for a change agent seem willing to overlook [other disagreements](https://substack.com/redirect/513885da-9f85-43c4-bb36-a285060d4853?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"Deciding to Win" focuses primarily on those other disagreements, while giving scant attention to the most important dynamic in American politics right now: Most people have stopped seeing our institutions--the institutions that brought us the Iraq War, the 2008 financial crisis, the hollowing out of manufacturing towns, the unchecked corruption of our campaign finance system, the rise of oligarchs, genocide in Gaza, and so on--as legitimate. This discontent, which Trump used to propel his right-wing authoritarian populism, can also be harnessed by left economic populism. But doing so requires defining the Democratic Party--in the clearest possible terms--as part of a bottom-versus-top axis of struggle. Trump didn't tack on a half-hearted "us versus them" patina to a standard Republican campaign--he made his vision of a battle between "the people" and MAGA's chosen scapegoats the centerpiece of everything he said and did. And it worked. Likewise, Senator Bernie Sanders makes his bottom-versus-top struggle against oligarchy the foundation of everything he says and does--and he is the most [popular](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6130ed-6153-4872-9116-e92692c05dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) elected official in the country.
When you center your party around that populist tentpole, you don't need to abandon existentially critical fights just because they're (according to an ideologically motivated centrist advocacy group) not currently the issues that poll best. For example, WelcomePAC argues--again and again in this report--that Democrats should stop pursuing climate action, not just in their rhetoric, but in their "approach to governance." It doesn't seem to matter to WelcomePAC that if we do nothing to tackle climate change, many [scientists](https://substack.com/redirect/a908122f-f696-45f2-82cb-78b2babe0b6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) fear human civilization on this planet could collapse. If there's a way to win that doesn't threaten the lives of billions of people, then that seems worth exploring.
Fortunately, there is. Rather than framing climate change as a niche social issue like WelcomePAC tries to do, populists like Sanders and Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez--as well as less left-coded populists like [Congressman Pat Ryan](https://substack.com/redirect/0b892733-38c5-4e6f-93e4-000fa100fc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--fold climate fights into their larger "us versus them" framework. They place Big Oil executives where they belong--within the oligarchy that "the people" must stand against. And they emphasize the many ways the climate crisis is materially harming working-class Americans. From the millions of families struggling with out-of-control home-insurance rates in climate disaster-prone areas, to the profound human and economic costs of these disasters, to the fact that electricity prices in many regions are skyrocketing because Trump is blocking communities from utilizing the cheapest form of energy (the sun) to force them to spend billions propping up uncompetitive coal plants, climate constantly offers compelling populist fights. But it only works if you have that broader populist tentpole to fit such struggles under.
In the end, there's a three-part formula for all of this, recently articulated by [David Sirota](https://substack.com/redirect/2cd57fba-16b4-4c50-8207-81cf247bbe73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), that I think serves as a useful shorthand for the big-picture dynamics that "Deciding to Win" ignores.
1. If Democratic Party leaders continue to define themselves by the most cliched, hackneyed version of [identity politics](https://substack.com/redirect/f22a6c0e-d2bf-446e-91bf-dd00415c38bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Democrats will have trouble winning in conservative and swing areas, because nobody likes that approach (other than the Democratic elites who [use it](https://substack.com/redirect/a4a1dc3c-d743-4512-a8c3-565ffe77950e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to defend themselves from left challengers).
2. If Democratic candidates try to define themselves as Republicans, they will also have trouble winning these areas, because voters will choose the real thing.
3. But if the Democratic Party can redefine itself as the party of economic populism--by fully committing to the struggle against oligarchy--then Democrats will be able to win in swing districts and redder states without abandoning climate and other important fights.

The problem for the Democratic Party, as Sirota points out, is that its larger apparatus--its donors, its current Congressional and recent presidential leaders, its revolving door of operatives and media figures, its WelcomePACs--are all set up to reinforce the first or second approaches, rather than the third. We can change that. But doing so requires a clearer, smarter, more ambitious vision than what's on offer in this report.
The authors of "Deciding to Win" have been framing themselves as courageous truth-tellers as if their gospel of mealy-mouthed moderation isn't exactly what Democratic elites want to hear. In reality, WelcomePAC's report isn't warning leaders like Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries that they're wearing no clothes--it's complimenting them on their lovely uniforms.
To win back power, the Democratic Party must reorganize itself as an anti-oligarchy party. That means taking on the oligarchic interests funding WelcomePAC and "Deciding to Win," which have every reason to scapegoat issues like the climate crisis in order to distract Democrats from their real problem: a party establishment that refuses to reckon with the reality of America's populist unrest.

# Bomb threats reported at NJ polling locations during gubernatorial election
**[Multiple bomb threats](https://substack.com/redirect/f49c1466-337a-47ed-99b2-804356f6e3b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/f49c1466-337a-47ed-99b2-804356f6e3b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)have been reported Tuesday morning in New jersey since polls have been open since 6am EST for the state's gubernatorial election.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a03d81e2-d126-4317-9bf3-ca03a737c344?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Mikie Sherrill is currently tight: New Jersey's demographic being **[38% democrat, 25% republican and 35% unaffiliated](https://substack.com/redirect/1bc5bafc-7dbd-44be-aa48-e06758dd859b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

# Trump's Truth Social post re-emerges as Comey hopes for case dismissal
Federal prosecutors Monday **[rejected James Comey's claims](https://substack.com/redirect/17863072-cc13-4c67-b87f-d19b1d4d51a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that political motives drove his indictment, telling a court that President Donald Trump's social media criticism of the former FBI director did not influence charging decisions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f69c90c4-069d-4e60-ba9c-f3bb6cf0368b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Justice Department** lawyers argued, in a 48-page filing, that Trump's September Truth Social post demanding prosecution of political opponents, including Comey, showed the president's opinion but not proof of vindictive intent.
* **Comey 's defense** team had sought dismissal of the statements and obstruction indictment on grounds of selective prosecution and improper appointment of the prosecutor, Trump's former personal attorney Lindsey Halligan.
* **The case stems** from a September grand jury indictment following the resignation of the previous U.S. Attorney, who reportedly faced White House pressure to bring charges, with trial scheduled for January 2026.
* * *
# Kimmel reaches out to Erika Kirk to apologize
The widow of late conservative activist Charlie Kirk **[declined an offer for talk show host Jimmy Kimmel to apologize](https://substack.com/redirect/097b2063-9b8d-40f1-b3f5-277f842c150f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on air for controversial comments he made about her husband's assassination, saying she doesn't want an insincere expression of regret.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/097b2063-9b8d-40f1-b3f5-277f842c150f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Erika Kirk told Fox News** that Sinclair Broadcast Group approached her about appearing on Kimmel's program for an apology, but she rejected the opportunity, stating it "is not our issue" and she only wants genuine remorse.
* **Kimmel faced suspension** from Disney after suggesting during a September monologue that the alleged shooter was connected to "MAGA" supporters, prompting major ABC station owners Sinclair and Nexstar to pull his show from their networks.
* **The 31-year-old Turning Point USA founder** was fatally shot during a speaking event at Utah Valley University on September 10, with suspect Tyler Robinson facing aggravated murder charges and potential execution by firing squad.

* * *
# Socialist candidate Mamdani casts NYC ballot for high-stakes election day
Democratic socialist **[Zohran Mamdani voted](https://substack.com/redirect/3b1dee40-640f-41c5-85da-c65fde1537c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/3b1dee40-640f-41c5-85da-c65fde1537c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Tuesday morning in New York City's mayoral election, backing housing ballot measures while his rivals prepare to cast their own ballots in a race that has drawn intense national and presidential attention.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18cc2c77-53f5-4626-b9f9-a8d6287630f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The 34-year-old assemblyman** arrived with his wife at an Astoria, Queens polling site around 8 a.m., where he disclosed supporting the first five ballot proposals including housing initiatives but opposing a measure that would align mayoral elections with presidential voting cycles.
* **Trump endorsed independent** candidate Andrew Cuomo hours before polls opened and threatened to slash federal funding to New York City if Mamdani wins, calling him a "communist" and urging Republicans not to waste votes on GOP nominee Curtis Sliwa.
* **Trump 's own words:** "Whether you personally like Andrew Cuomo or not, **[you really have no choice.](https://substack.com/redirect/18cc2c77-53f5-4626-b9f9-a8d6287630f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** You must vote for him, and hope he does a fantastic job. He is capable of it, Mamdani is not!"
* **Voting continues** until 9 p.m. across all five boroughs, concluding a contentious campaign in which Cuomo positioned himself as the pragmatic choice to prevent what he characterized as Mamdani's unrealistic policy promises.

[Pledge your support](https://substack..kJWePsQ2YbAWyQyEk3ZS2B_bX-GDsQPv5ieOVDeIweY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=177979093)

Tucker's quote with a question by Pastor AC Cordell
_**There was a season where those like Candice and Tucker promoted an Agenda that advanced our country and inspired those to return this country to its republican roots, but like anything else that season is up.**_
**The Hebrew Hammer**
This weekend we saw Rep. Randy Fine (R-Fla.) celebrate his Jewish heritage at the Republican Jewish Coalition conference that he is the "first member of Congress in American history to wear a kippah" so that his children's friends at college feel confident and comfortable wearing a yarmulke at school. His speech was a response to right-wing antisemites such as Tucker Carlson and Nick Fuentes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce481cf4-f56b-49c6-951b-44d3a08de018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Florida Republican Congressman Randy Fine attacks Tucker Carlson at the Republican Jewish Coalition convention in Las Vegas, Nevada, on Saturday November 1 2025 (RJC/X)
**The Rise of Alt-Right "Christians"**
Those 3 Musketeers of Misery do not represent the MAGA movement, but there is a growing group of misinformed Alt-Right people claiming to be Christian. _**It is easy for a Jew to denounce antisemitism, but the real power is in Christians that stand up for Jews and Israel and against antisemitism and this wave of biblically illiterate "Christians."**_
Being an Antisemitic Christian is about as oxymoronic as a Kosher Jew who eats Shrimp and a Bacon Cheeseburger. A Jew who votes for a Democrat Socialist is a mental disorder and I pray that they fail in bringing Commie Mamdani, Muslim wolf in sheep's clothing, to power on election day.
_**Unfortunately, we see more Jews for Zohran and that is the same energy of Jews that supported Hitler.**_
**Where are Christians on Antisemitism?**
This weekend we attended the National Association of Christian Lawmakers (NACL) founded by Jason Rapert, a former state senator from Arkansas. _"**The mission of NACL is to honor the Judeo-Christian principles of the United States and unite federal, state, and local lawmakers in support of clear biblical principles by meeting regularly to network, discuss major issues, and propose model statutes, ordinances, and resolutions to address significant policy concerns from a biblical worldview.** "_
**Grafted In**
A real Christian, not one in name only, reads the Bible. They study the Old Testament and the New Testament. If you follow both books, you can't have the New without the old and Christianity does not begin at the crucifixion. Jesus was and still is Jewish. He is the messiah for a Christian.
_**What is important is Romans 11:17 -**_
_**" YOU, WHO WERE ONCE NOTHING MORE THAN A WILD OLIVE BRANCH, GOD HAS GRAFTED IN -INSERTING YOU AMONG THE REMAINING BRANCHES AS A JOINT PARTNER TO SHARE IN THE WONDERFUL RICHNESS OF THE CULTIVATED OLIVE STEM."**_
I spoke with Pastor Walter Hayes who named his ministry Grafted in; he explained his deep views of what that means to him and his wife Regina and why Christians love their Jewish brethren and Israel. He is also being called to run for office for a State seat in Missouri.
Pastor Hayes explained the Christian belief _**(as**_ _**written in the scripture**_) that Christians are grafted into the tree of Judaism as brothers and the tree cannot survive if you take out its jewish roots. I have read it and encourage Jews to read it too.
**NACL Responds to Tucker and Candice and Others who denounce "Christian Zionism"**
Following the antisemitic remarks, NACL President Jason Rapert of the NACL [responded on X](https://substack.com/redirect/b635919c-7f1b-4556-a085-ae19af7407bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as follows:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8bb84c4-496b-474d-8e3f-b8a1d14547ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I am the founder and president of the [National Association of Christian Lawmakers](https://substack.com/redirect/a5c8cfbe-0460-425f-adb6-4f396304cacd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- representing Christian elected officials from all 50 states, who proudly bring their Biblical values into their roles as lawmakers. They serve at the local, state and federal levels of government.
We are conservative Christians who are very patriotic Americans. We want to be clear: God stands with Israel, America is one nation under God, and therefore we stand with God who clearly stands with Israel!
We stand solidly with our friends in Israel and the Jewish people. Rooted in Scripture, Genesis 12:3 declares: "I will bless those who bless you." In these trying times, we affirm God's covenant with Abraham's descendants, praying for Jerusalem's peace (Psalm 122:6) and rejecting all forms of antisemitism at home and around the world.
Amid the current controversy over whether conservative commentators or organizations should platform individuals with antisemitic, Hitler-promoting, or Holocaust-denying views - I am honestly disgusted by those who do that. We can uphold free speech as enshrined in the U.S. Constitution, while also rebuking those who say horrible and evil things. That's our right under free speech as well!
We have opposed the tactics used in so-called cancel culture and defend everyone's right to speak. However, we also believe those who platform such views have a duty to strongly challenge them, as Ephesians 5:11 urges: "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them." Silence in the face of evil promotes it, echoing James 4:17: "Whoever knows the right thing to do and fails to do it, for him it is sin."
Our leaders at [@ChristLawmakers ](https://substack.com/redirect/6107057d-3640-4a74-9122-3efec4b8601d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)boldly put America first. We also have passed legislation and resolutions to support Israel, rebuke Hamas, and fight against antisemitism. I am personally disappointed and disgusted with the shocking antisemitic rhetoric we hear coming from @RealCandaceO and @TuckerCarlson and some others who have seemingly lost their way. They speak out of ignorance or they are purposely twisting the truth when they claim to be Christians and then use their words to attack Israel and drive a wedge between Christians and Jews. Jesus was JEWISH.
**The Apostle Paul was JEWISH. The authors of the New Testament Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John), the epistles, and the Book of Acts, were all JEWISH. The early Christian movement was a sect of Judaism, and its foundational texts reflect this JEWISH origin and identity.**
I personally rebuke the voices of antisemitism in the United States and those who seek to destroy our alliance with Israel. Judea, Samaria, and all of the Galilee belong to ISRAEL and they have complete sovereignty to govern it as they see fit. I invite other Christian and conservative political voices to join me and proclaim the same.
_**This response/reaction by Jason Rapert is illuminating and is representative of how Jews should view those Christians who actually read the book while challenging the ignorant Alt-Right "Christians" the same way sane Jews challenge cultural Jews who are jewish for the jokes and support a democrat socialist. These are the same Jews who will not go to Israel and think Trump is antisemitic while they support an actual anti-Semite and march in Free Palestine marches.**_
**Other Reactions to Tucker**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b0f7378-6a07-4f41-85ae-b8e0ec5fe1c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Luke Moon](https://substack.com/redirect/088e6145-a32e-4ed8-824c-8f8908a8082d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After Tucker, so many other Pastors messaged me and I offered my love and support for their love and support for Israel.
_**This is why I have spent the last 2 years in churches as a Jewish man to share the love back with my Christian brethren who pray for the peace of Jerusalem and for those who bless Israel in government and in the world. I witness these Christians go to Israel and Sowing Seeds in the land.**_
These Christian Brothers and Sisters are probably more connected to Israel than most Jews, especially here in America.
**October 7 was an Awakening for Christians and Jews**
During the Holocaust, very few Christians stood up for Jews and unfortunately this shut the jewish world to many Christians and sowed the seeds of division. There were exceptions like Dietrich Bonhoeffer and Martin Niemoller.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ac97636-7336-4893-adbe-74cd8cbfe55a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_**With the atrocities of October 7th, there was a Christian revival. Christian leaders, unapologetic of their "Christian Zionism" came out from everywhere and stood for the Jewish people. They didn't care about the backlash and they stood up for what was right and led missions into Israel.**_
Some were there when it happened like Bishop Robert Stearns of [Eagles' Wing Ministries](https://substack.com/redirect/b812272f-ba71-49f3-8b3e-49392faba0bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and
Aaron "AC" Cordell of [Resting Place Detroit](https://substack.com/redirect/8995efbf-69d3-44db-a141-9ae9f755946b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Nation 2 Nation](https://substack.com/redirect/80fa1b99-6545-4514-a47c-eb1b132a629b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and they just started filming and broadcasting the horror as it was unfolding.
_**Their firsthand accounts help to inform the Christian world about the real situation knowing that when it comes to Israel, media is its enemy (the 8th front of war).**_
And there are so many others I have spent time with and broken bread with and that list is long. With the antisemitism here in America, I also want to acknowledge Pastor Dumisani Washington, founder and CEO of the [Institute for Black Solidarity with Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/b663ffea-77dc-4fc3-8547-3618d3f02bd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (IBSI) and his voice in support of the Jews by strengthening the relationship between Israel, the Jewish people, and people of African descent through education and advocacy.
_**For the Jews of the world, cast aside your global misperceptions that the Christians hate the Jews and just want to convert you. Without Judaism there is no Christianity. Jesus was, is, and will always be Jewish -and Christians are grafted in to the rich olive tree of our existence.**_
Ignore and denounce the Alt-Right and Rebuke the toxicity of the biblically illiterate or misinformed "Christian" who denounces Christian Zionism.
**You can still be America First and love and support Israel like I do.**
**Thank God for the Christians I know.**

This response/reaction by Jason Rapert is illuminating and is representative of how Jews should view those Christians who actually read the book while challenging the ignorant Alt-Right "Christians" the same way sane Jews challenge cultural Jews who are jewish for the jokes and support a democrat socialist. This is why I have spent the last 2 years in churches as a Jewish man to share the love back with my Christian brethren who pray for the peace of Jerusalem and for those who bless Israel in government and in the world. I witness these Christians go to Israel and Sowing Seeds in the land. These Christian Brothers and Sisters are probably more connected to Israel than most Jews, especially here in America. For the Jews of the world, cast aside your global misperceptions that the Christians hate the Jews and just want to convert you. Without Judaism there is no Christianity. Jesus was, is, and will always be Jewish -and Christians are grafted in to the rich olive tree of our existence. Immigrant. Marine. Mom. Small Business Owner. Lieutenant Governor. I’m Winsome Earle-Sears, and I’ve held many titles in my life. Each one hasn’t been a cakewalk, but I like a challenge. body:
I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed. In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was some demon, the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "I'm in your basement."

| | [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze590mg0easer4nk8q7c1srqbfnfsbs6qpbe1tko_rp22sh2s8i6eor2c9iecor2c5h2bs) [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3vvafpcpldmfjuetflhbtafsfcta4694pv97bdo_rp22sh2s8i6eor2c9iecor2c5h2bs) Dear Patriot,

I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed.

In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was **some demon** , the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "**I'm in your basement.** "

I sat up immediately, not knowing if it was real or a dream. My hands ran alongside my bed to feel the fabric in the darkness. It took some time to recognize that I was awake. I looked at my nightstand, and there was no phone.

Those who know much more about God and the Devil than I do say that this is an example of spiritual warfare. They tell me that it's meant to terrify me, to make me question myself and my own sanity. **These nightmares, this evil, come just before a story OMG will be breaking that I believe will expose evil in a way we've never seen before**.

The story was placed on hold due to the shock and grief we've all felt for Charlie Kirk. I used to run stories by Charlie to get his feedback. I relayed our next release to Charlie before he was shot. It was the last text Charlie Kirk ever sent me. I prefer to keep the message private, but he understood the significance of the story and that **it strikes at the heart of evil in our nation.**

I'm reluctant to "hype" stories anymore. That's not my intent. But I am asking for your help.

First, I'm humbly asking for your prayers for me and OMG's staff. If you're a believer, I don't need to say anything else, other than "thank you."

Secondly, [**your support is needed**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za56f16rti8qfhmh4i7egivded0h39fobs36gd2g_rp22sh2s8i6eor2c9iecor2c5h2bs). [**Any amount that you can contribute is appreciated**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsjaqfgqgj7ua6qfufg6gasqe1mqf440ts69g2mo_rp22sh2s8i6eor2c9iecor2c5h2bs).

This story was one of our least expensive to produce, and you'll see why when it comes out. But it will open the floodgates of truth, and we need to be prepared for that. This story has the potential to change the world, but that's not up to me. OMG, reports the truth, the world decides. But I would be negligent in my duties if we're not prepared to deal with a flood of high-level whistleblowers after this release. And that's where your support is needed. [**Please, donate whatever you can today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl8cq8736nssaqq8ikrhn6p6tnt0lu99i8336q98_rp22sh2s8i6eor2c9iecor2c5h2bs).

Thank you again for all that you do and, as always, stay tuned.

In Truth, James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

| Peter,
Tonight the polls close in the Pennsylvania Supreme Court retention election. Losing this court means Democrats would never win PA again. This is why Defend our Courts has knocked 100k+ doors, texted and mailed over a million PA voters, and ran one of the largest TV and digital ad programs in this race.
We have one last chance to influence the outcome of this life or death race. Turnout is lagging in Philly and the voter file shows there are 38,000 high propensity Democratic voters (folks who've never missed an off year election) who have yet to vote today.

## Vance steps up to the plate...
JD Vance might be Vice President, but he's already showcasing his ability to lead.
VP isn't usually a very flashy job, yet Vance is taking a leading role in this administration.
We've seen it in foreign policy and domestic issues-- it's clear that he's got what it takes to lead the next generation of conservatives.
Looking ahead to 2028, this is great news for the right.
Just last week he appeared at a Turning Point USA event, both speaking and taking questions from an audience at Ole Miss.
You don't see that often.
One of the most powerful men in the world, willing to engage with college students--many of whom disagree with him.
That's the kind of hands-on leadership that we need.
It's just the latest proof that Vance has got what it takes to guide the next generation.
Let's break it down...

# [#]
It’s Raul.

Thanks to you, we reached our end-of-month fundraising goal — and I couldn’t be more grateful.

You’ve always shown up when it matters most, standing with me to protect and strengthen CA-25. Together, we’ve accomplished so much for our community. But right now, many of our friends and neighbors are facing incredibly tough times.

We’re now in the second month of the Republican government shutdown. And as of November 1, families struggling to feed their kids will no longer receive the help they need from the SNAP food assistance program.

That means millions of people across the country — and thousands right here at home — are suddenly without the help they rely on to feed their families.

Parents are wondering how they’ll put dinner on the table. Kids are showing up to school hungry. And all of it is completely avoidable.

Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans could fund SNAP today. They could come to the table, reopen the government, and make sure no child goes hungry — but so far, they’ve refused.

So I’m asking you: will you add your name to demand that Donald Trump and his allies in Congress fund SNAP and end this shutdown? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/p_SGegcrVk6Ao4CPsKkL9w2]

ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/p_SGegcrVk6Ao4CPsKkL9w2]

First, I want to assure you that my offices will continue to remain open throughout the shutdown. My team and I are here to help you and your family — whether you need assistance with federal benefits, services, or simply need to be heard.

We’re in this fight together, and I’ll never stop working to make government work for you.

Thank you,

Raul

is one of the pioneers of classical Christian homeschooling, Leigh Bortins.

Leigh, an aerospace engineer who homeschooled her own four sons together with her husband, founded Classical Conversations to
bring a comprehensive curriculum to families across the United States. An expert on the tools of learning, Leigh has much to share

How Homeschooling Can Impact Your Child's Future for Good

There used to be a stereotype that homeschool families were isolated and underperforming. Nothing could be further from the truth!
With more families than ever opting for home-centered education, the public perception is changing. More people are realizing the
benefits of homeschooling for children today and for their future.

This week, we're looking at some of the common objections to homeschooling and the myths that remain. What is the truth and could
homeschooling be a good fit for your family?

clean_body: Why is homeschooling more popular than ever? We're bringing on an expert to learn about the latest developments in homeschooling and the benefits for our children's future. If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] [] November 4, 2025 • Newsletter The Rise of Homeshool Education Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] The failures of public education have led to a growing movement of home-centered education. Joining the Moms for America Podcast is one of the pioneers of classical Christian homeschooling, Leigh Bortins. Leigh, an aerospace engineer who homeschooled her own four sons together with her husband, founded Classical Conversations to bring a comprehensive curriculum to families across the United States. An expert on the tools of learning, Leigh has much to share about what has gone wrong in public education and what families can do to successfully homeschool through high school. Listen in to this inspiring conversation! Like, subscribe and share. # New Yorks future hangs in the balance as election day dawns
New York City **[teeters on the edge of a precipice](https://substack.com/redirect/d33133d1-4f40-4f38-b43e-feb43857f629?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani remains ahead in polls to replace scandal-tainted Eric Adams as Mayor of New York as Today's election comes down to the wire.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d33133d1-4f40-4f38-b43e-feb43857f629?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Mamdani 's Progressive Vision**: Democratic nominee Zohran Mamdani, a Ugandan-born assemblyman, is pushing rent freezes, free buses, and city-run grocery stores, a socialist agenda fueling his primary win over Cuomo despite substantial business elite backlash.
* **Cuomo 's Independent Gambit Unfolds**: Ex-Gov. Andrew Cuomo, who resigned amid harassment claims, is running as independent with Adams' surprise endorsement, prioritizing police expansion and affordable housing to claw back moderate support.
* **Sliwa Faces Dropout Pressure** : Republican Curtis Sliwa, founder of the Guardian Angels who is proposing 7,000 new police officers, has faced calls to exit the race and bolster Cuomo, aiming to consolidate anti-Mamdani votes in a tight race.
* **Trump, PACs Stoke Fierce Backlash** : President Trump has labeled Mamdani a "communist" that will ruin New York while endorsing Cuomo. Billionaire PACs have targeted the socialist with more than $40 million in spending, highlighting national stakes in America's financial capital.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47fb9b01-5361-40bd-85a0-8ab9e7bfe804?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0e389d2a-2016-45e9-a563-5e8193284df4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In a last-ditch push before New York's mayoral election, disgraced socialist UK politician Jeremy Corbyn urged **[supporters in the UK to join a phone bank](https://substack.com/redirect/be203c06-1ccc-43db-85f1-01f42e12e1d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to rally voters for far-left candidate Zohran Mamdani, igniting Republican cries of brazen foreign election interference.
* **Corbyn 's Polarizing Profile Emerges**: The former leftwing Labour leader, who was ousted over antisemitism scandals, remotely bolstered Mamdani's get out the vote event, drawing ire for his radical views mirroring the candidate's socialist agenda.
* **GOP Lawmakers Unleash Backlash** : Reps. Steil, Tenney, and Malliotakis slammed the stunt as sovereignty breach, with Steil tying it to pending bills curbing foreign influence in U.S. races.
* **Mamdani 's Controversial Record Spotlighted**: Mamdani faces heat for anti-Israel rhetoric, an illegal foreign donations probe, and policies like state-run grocery stores, alarming Jewish leaders amid rising NYC antisemitism and those opposed to Mamdani's hyper-left agenda.
* **Broader Election Integrity Echoes** : The incident evokes Obama-era meddling claims against Israel during national elections, fueling calls to reject Mamdani and tighten laws, potentially swaying undecided voters in tight mayoral contest.
